Title: A Beautiful Day
Summary: Gene wakes up knowing a decision he has made will change his life forever.
Producer: Casey Cannon, Angeliki Giannakopoulos, Phedon Papamichael

Title: My Daughter Was Taken
Summary: A woman traveling in Spain witnesses her daughter being attacked during a video call. With her daughter missing and no trace of the assault, she'll stop at nothing to uncover the truth and save her.

Title: Isabel
Summary: This moody Canadian thriller follows the beautiful Isabel (Geneviève Bujold) as she leaves Montreal and returns to the coastal Quebec farm where she grew up. Discovering that her mother has died, Isabel stays on the farm to assist her uncle (Gerard Parkes) with the daily chores. Her presence there stirs up disturbing memories of violence and death in the family, and soon Isabel is tormented by dark visions that leave her increasingly unsettled and fearful.

Title: Head
Summary: A delivery boy receives a package containing a renowned scientist's head. When he is kidnapped, his sister must find the hidden package before her brother is killed.

Title: Immortal
Summary: A well-respected lawyer, engaged to a socially conscious young woman, has a moment of weakness that leaves an aftermath of guilt and heartbreak.
Screenwriter: Agha Jani Kashmiri, S. Ali Raza, Mehrish, S. K. Kalla, B. S. Ramaiah

Title: Under Lock and Key
Summary: An FBI agent goes undercover in a women's prison in search of a codebook to help topple a drug dealer. When she is removed from the case, her daughter is then kidnapped, and she enlists the help of a security guard to tackle the mob.
Screenwriter: Henri Charr, Jess Mancilla, John B. Pfeifer, Taesung Yim

Title: Love Spell
Summary: Lucas and Bebel decide to get married and have no idea that religion will be a reason for family discord; while the bride's father wants to strengthen Jewish traditions, Luke's mother wants her son to take Umbanda traditions to his future family.
Screenwriter: Caroline Fioratti, Marcelo Andrade, Carolina Castro

Title: Spin Wars
Summary: SoulCycle, Flywheel, Peloton -- the billion-dollar boutique fitness revolution built on ambition, betrayal and toxic sweat. This high-energy documentary exposes the dark side of "mind, body, soul" culture with deliciously colorful insiders.

Title: Skiff
Summary: Fifteen-year-old Malou is struggling with herself. She grows up in a small town, where in the local rowing club, she excels at the sport. While her mother is absent and her rowing teammates bully her, the one person she can rely on is her older brother Max. When Malou develops feelings for Max's new girlfriend Nouria, her life is dragged into an unstoppable current. Malou has to face her true self, may it be at the expense of her brother.

Title: Landship
Summary: Set during the 1917 Battle of Passchendaele, a nine-man British MKIV tank crew embarks on a mission to destroy German bunkers. But when they become trapped in a shell crater just yards from enemy lines, they must band together to fight for survival against starvation, shellshock, and relentless enemy fire.

Title: The Delivery
Summary: Desperate for cash to save their business, three people agree to smuggle $25 million worth of drugs from Amsterdam to Barcelona.

Title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
Summary: TRUST ME, I'M A DOCTOR follows Dr. Sandeep Kapoor after his life is turned upside down when he is implicated in the death of his former patient, model and reality television star Anna Nicole Smith. Set against the height of the early 2000s tabloid era, the film chronicles Kapoor's fight to clear his name as paparazzi descend on his office, police raid his home, private journals are leaked, and every aspect of his personal life becomes public. With the guidance of respected attorney Ellyn Garofalo, Kapoor must navigate a high-stakes drug conspiracy trial while confronting the intersection of celebrity, justice, politics and personal redemption.
Producer: Ryan Hawkins, Alex Engemann, Rebecca Case, Geenah Krisht

Title: Beast
Summary: In a small island community, a troubled young woman falls for a mysterious outsider who empowers her to escape her oppressive family. When he comes under suspicion for a series of murders, she defends him at all costs.
Producer: Kristian Brodie, Lauren Dark, Ivana Mackinnon
Production Co: BFI Film Fund, Film4, Roadside Attractions, Entertainment One, British Film Institute, Les Films Séville

Title: A Sad and Beautiful World
Summary: Across three decades of passion, loss, and hope, Nino and Yasmina are bound by a magnetic relationship. Torn between love and survival, they must decide whether to build a family and seek happiness in Lebanon or leave their home amid the country’s unfolding tragedies.
Producer: Jennifer Goyne Blake, Georg Neubert, Georges Schoucair, April Shih, Jasper Wiedhöft
Production Co: Abbout Productions, Reynard Films, Diversity Hire

Title: Death at the Dinner Party
Summary: Andrea visits her son, Ethan, at college and discovers a psychology professor has taken him under his wing. But when Ethan's friend dies at one of the teacher's dinner parties, Andrea starts to suspect foul play.

Title: Breeder
Summary: A health supplement company starts abducting young women as part of an experiment that bio-hacks babies' DNA to enable clients to reverse the aging process. When Mia sets out to investigate this shady business, she ends up getting trapped in the human farm's web.
Producer: Amalie Lyngbo Quist, Maria Møller Christoffersen
Screenwriter: Sissel Dalsgaard Thomsen, Sissel Dalsgaard Thomsen

Title: Displaced
Summary: A humanoid alien and a British soldier team up to locate a top-secret file that contains information about advanced energy production.

Title: Baggage Claim
Summary: Although she has traveled all over the world, flight attendant Montana Moore has yet to find a man with whom she wants to settle down. However, her sister's upcoming wedding and pressure from her often-married mother force her to calculate that she has a month to find a fiancé of her own. Montana's best friends and fellow flight attendants conspire to help her re-encounter her exes as they travel across the country, but the right man may be closer than she thinks.
Producer: Steven J. Wolfe, David E. Talbert
Production Co: Sneak Preview Entertainment, Fox Searchlight Pictures, TSG Entertainment

Title: Cecil
Summary: In 1996, fourth grader Cecil Stevens is reminded of his terrible lisp every time he says his name. To avoid social travesty, he decides to change his unpronounceable name to Michael Jordan.
Production Co: Behind the Curtain Media, Blind Turn Films

Title: The Gang
Summary: A foreigner runs a drug racket on the beach with help of locals and the coast guard.

Title: Under the Flags, the Sun
Summary: Through rare and long-forgotten footage, this documentary uncovers the hidden machinery of Alfredo Stroessner's dictatorship in Paraguay--one of history's longest-running regimes. From propaganda to international broadcasts, the film exposes how media shaped power, controlled memory, and built a legacy that still lingers today.

Title: Love Apptually
Summary: Love Apptually traces a journey from enchantment to awareness, revealing not just the mechanics of dating apps, but the deeper ways they shape how we relate, desire, and connect. It asks: who designs these systems, what do they optimize for, and at what cost to our humanity? Ultimately, Love Apptually is an invitation--to pause, to see clearly, and to choose more consciously how we connect.

Title: Melody
Summary: Grade schoolers Melody (Tracy Hyde) and Daniel (Mark Lester) are completely earnest in their desire to wed one another. Unfortunately, no one seems to understand the ardor of their loving bond. Their parents and teachers find the marriage proposition ridiculous, and Daniel's closest pal, Ornshaw (Jack Wild), doesn't want to lose his buddy to a girl. However, the mischievous Ornshaw eventually warms to the idea, and helps Daniel and Melody escape the cruel clutches of the adults.

Title: Toni Braxton's Breathe Again
Summary: Rejected as contestants on a reality TV dating show, three women form an unlikely sisterhood that carries them from Los Angeles to Seattle. They soon navigate fresh starts, second chances and the messy realities of dating, friendship and family.

Title: Mirage
Summary: In a Macedonian town, a schoolboy (Marko Kovacevic) named Marko finds refuge from a terrible home life and attacks from bullies by keeping a low profile and hanging around the rail yard. A teacher (Mustafa Nadarevic) discovers Marko's hidden talent for poetry and encourages him to enter a contest, but then a soldier (Nikola Djuricko) arrives on the scene and teaches him a more violent set of skills.

Title: Stavros Halkias: Uncle Stav
Summary: In this unruly set, Stavros Halkias imagines becoming a "dirtbag" uncle, roasts the health care system and warns of the risks of living your best life.

Title: Home.
Summary: A homeless teenager meets another homeless boy on the streets, and they team up to survive.

Title: Ends Meat
Summary: Desperate to do right by his children, a debt-ridden taxi driver has just one night left to deliver on a lucrative, yet sinister promise.

Title: A Prayer for the Dying
Summary: Irish Republican Army member Martin Fallon (Mickey Rourke) rigs a bomb to destroy a British army convoy, but the plan goes wrong when the trucks allow a school bus to pass. Now, Fallon wants out. He's through killing for the cause, but in order to secure safe passage to the U.S., he'll have to take one more job: eliminating rival terrorist Krasko (Stanley Beard). Unfortunately, a priest (Bob Hoskins) complicates matters by witnessing the hit, but Fallon believes he knows how to keep him silent.
Screenwriter: Jack Higgins, Edmund Ward, Martin Lynch

Title: Crude Awakenings
Summary: Hoping to land a promotion, an ambitious publicist at a PR firm takes on a notorious energy company. She must soon decide whether to sacrifice her moral compass and surrender her health in favor of financial success.
Producer: Omri Dayan, Selma Ernestrand, Costanza Marinese

Title: She Stole My Son's Heart
Summary: After her last heart transplant fails, a young woman turns down her boyfriend's proposal and disappears, prompting a race to uncover the truth behind her disappearance before her heart gives out.
Production Co: CMW Spring Productions, Studio TF1 America

Title: Terry McMillan Presents: Tempted 2 Love
Summary: Accompanied by her new boyfriend, a chef crosses paths with her ex while headlining a prestigious event in Portugal. Their attraction and love for each other soon forces them to decide once again what's best for their careers and relationship.
Producer: Vaughn W. Hebron, Boris Kodjoe, D'Angela Proctor Steed

Title: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny
Summary: This documentary revisits the French football team's controversial 2010 World Cup and the bus strike that sparked global headlines and national outrage.
Screenwriter: Olivier Bouchara, Pierre Gault, Elisabeth Yturbe, Seamus Haley

Title: Wild
Summary: After an encounter with a wolf, a young woman (Lilith Stangenberg) casts off societal conventions to live a life free of hypocrisy.

Title: Goodman
Summary: A man begins to lose his faith.

Title: Resilience
Summary: Jimmy gets in trouble with a powerful man and must choose between his life and someone else's.

Title: Red Rocks
Summary: On the French Riviera, two gangs of kids compete in the perilous game of cliff jumping. Géo, barely five years old, discovers over the course of a summer a world where friendship blends with rivalry, and where the first stirrings of the heart emerge against the dazzling Mediterranean landscape.
Producer: Joaquim Sapinho, Marta Alves, Fiorella Moretti

Title: The Strangers
Summary: Kristen (Liv Tyler) and James (Scott Speedman) are expecting a relaxing weekend at a family vacation home, but their stay turns out to be anything but peaceful. First, a mysterious and dangerous woman arrives at the door while James is out on an errand. When he returns, he accidentally kills his friend Mike (Glenn Howerton), mistaking him for an intruder. And then real danger does show up -- in the form of three masked torturers, leaving Kristen and James struggling for survival.
Producer: Doug Davison, Roy Lee, Nathan Kahane
Production Co: Mandate Pictures, Vertigo, Intrepid Pictures, Rogue Pictures, E1 Entertainment

Title: Paper Planes
Summary: After he wins his school's paper plane making contest, 11-year-old Dylan and his father bond as Dylan prepares for the World Paper Plane Championships in Tokyo.
Producer: Robert Connolly, Maggie Miles, Liz Kearney

Title: Madness
Summary: Jenna and Tara pick up Chad and Oliver on the road and have a great time, until sadistic killers capture the group and torture them to death one by one.
Director: Sonny Laguna, David Liljeblad, Tommy Wiklund
Screenwriter: Sonny Laguna, David Liljeblad, Tommy Wiklund

Title: The Test
Summary: Harry, preparing to leave on a business trip, tells Bessie that her photograph will always be with him. To test his sincerity, she removes the photo from his bill case.

Title: Turtle Rock
Summary: A family begins to feel isolated in a remote village.

Title: Daydream
Summary: The experiences of some Liverpudlians illustrate their city's inexorable change.

Title: Phenomena
Summary: An American (Jennifer Connelly) at a Swiss finishing school calls on insects to help a paralyzed scientist (Donald Pleasence) fight a monster.

Title: Silver City
Summary: A campaign manager hires a private detective (Danny Huston) after a Colorado gubernatorial candidate finds a dead body while fishing.

Title: Dark Places
Summary: The true value of an estate brings out the worst in the deceased's doctor (Christopher Lee), lawyer, sister (Joan Collins) and rightful heir (Robert Hardy).
Screenwriter: Ed Brennan, Joseph Van Winkle, James Hannah Jr., Don Sharp

Title: Be Mine
Summary: A gay man's friends embark on a romantic crusade to get him to experience his first kiss.

Title: Lucky
Summary: After narrowly escaping a molester, Lucky seeks shelter in Aditya's car. A terrorist attack breaks out, but the two stand by each other. This is the story of two people who discover the limits of their endurance, and more importantly, love.

Title: Chinese Whispers
Summary: Young children whisper a secret in a circle.

Title: When We Get There
Summary: Cal and Ty are graduating college when their mother dies, discovering a letter to the father they've never met. With Cal's girlfriend Ellie, they set out on a road trip that tests their bonds and forces them to face grief, forgiveness, and what family truly means before stepping into the future.
Producer: Josh Tessier, Brady Hallongren, Ryan Patrick Welsh, Justin Giddings, Brent Foshee, Justin Anderson, Roberto Ahumada, Omid Zader
Production Co: Giddy Welshmen Productions, Whiskey Panda Studios

Title: Honey Bunch
Summary: Diana's husband is taking her to an experimental trauma facility deep in the wilderness, but she can't remember why.... As her memories begin to creep back in so do some unwelcome sinister truths about her marriage.
Producer: Madeleine Sims-Fewer, Dusty Mancinelli, Becky Yeboah
Production Co: Cat People, Rhombus Media, XYZfilms, IPR.VC

Title: Traces
Summary: A man (Alan Feinstein) sets out to find out how his son died, instead discovering how he lived.

Title: A Gift from Heaven
Summary: A six-year-old boy from a single-parent family finds his "god-given father," revealing secrets and ironic fates that ask: what is the true treasure in life?

Title: Seahorse: The Dad Who Gave Birth
Summary: Filmmaker Jeanie Finlay documents a transgender man's path to parenthood after he decides to carry his child himself.

Title: Uprooted
Summary: Choice is a luxury the Palestinians cannot afford: if they cease to resist, they cease to breathe and they cease to live.

Title: BRB
Summary: Set in the fleeting era of dial-up and away messages, BRB follows 15-year-old Sam, who embarks on a road trip with her older sister Dylan to meet the boy she fell for in a chatroom. What starts as a quest to meet a first love, descends into a chaotic, painfully funny journey of two young women trying to unravel the tender and chaotic intersections of girlhood. BRB is a love letter to early internet girlhood, to complicated sisters, and to anyone who's ever felt both invisible and exposed all at once.
Production Co: In the Rye Productions, Chicago Media Angels

Title: Shocktopus
Summary: An alien amoeba crashes to Earth and mutates aquatic life along the shores of North Carolina, unleashing an electrified octopus that terrorizes a seaside resort. Two special operatives try to stop the shock wave of cosmic carnage.

Title: Same Same but Different
Summary: A German student goes back to Cambodia to help a sick saloon girl and learns an important lesson.
Producer: Claus Boje, Detlev Buck, Jeanette Würl

Title: Hard Feelings
Summary: A bullied New York teen (Carl Marotte) runs away and meets a young woman (Charlayne Woodard) who gives him strength in 1963 Georgia.

Title: Mata Hari
Summary: The life of Margaretha Geertruida Zelle.
Producer: Annie Carradine, Paul Hunt, Raf Santana

Title: Night Shift
Summary: Chuck (Henry Winkler) has given up life as a stockbroker because it was too stressful. Now, he works an easy gig as a night shift attendant at a New York City morgue. His co-worker, Bill Blazejowski (Michael Keaton), on the other hand, is always looking to make a quick buck. When Bill finds out that Chuck's prostitute neighbor, Belinda (Shelley Long), needs a place to do her work, he convinces Chuck to turn the morgue into a brothel where they can work as her pimps.

Title: With Hasan in Gaza
Summary: Constructed from three MiniDV tapes shot in Gaza in 2001 and rediscovered years later, the film transforms recovered footage into a profound cinematic meditation on memory, loss, and the passage of time. Originally conceived as a search for a former prison mate from 1989, the film unfolds into an unexpected road trip from the north to the south of Gaza with Hasan, a local guide whose fate remains unknown. As the camera moves through Gaza's streets and landscapes, it records fleeting moments of everyday life--fragments of a reality now irreversibly altered. With Hasan in Gaza throws mainstream images of a people displaced into relief through the traces of absence bygone time evokes.

Title: The Day She Returns
Summary: The Day She Returns follows actress Bae Jeongsu (Song Seon-mi), who, having stepped back from acting after marriage and a subsequent divorce, returns to the profession with a role in an independent film. As the film's release approaches, she takes part in a series of press interviews, only to discover later--when asked to revisit those moments in her acting class--that she cannot clearly recall what was said. She is tired and wants to go home. Her daughter is waiting. Infused with quiet observation and subtle humor, his 34th feature is a meditation on memory and performance, and the subtle interplay between the two. The Day She Returns features a compelling central performance by Song Seon-mi, alongside longtime collaborators Cho Yunhee (The Day After) and Park Mi-so (Introduction). Continuing Hong Sang-soo's distinctive exploration of the boundaries between lived experience and artistic creation, the film unfolds in his signature minimalist style, marked by intimate conversations, precise compositions, and a gently unfolding sense of time.

Title: Magazine
Producer: Alexandra Pechman, Anne Alexander, Tess Cohen

Title: On Paper
Summary: A book editor (Lindsay Hartley) searches for Mr. Right while working with a high-maintenance author (Morgan Fairchild).

Title: Who Could Kill a Sweet Old Lady?
Summary: When Edie becomes the caregiver for a wealthy, elderly woman, she starts to suspect that someone wants her client dead -- and she's the only one standing in their way.

Title: Speed Kills
Summary: A wealthy speedboat racer leads a double life that gets him into trouble with the law and drug lords.
Production Co: Saban Films, JTP Films, Blue Rider Pictures, Hannibal Pictures

Title: Meat
Summary: A pimp (Peter Wight) seeks vengeance when a prostitute (Sarah-Jane Potts) falls in love with a former convict (Jonny Lee Miller) and becomes pregnant.

Title: A Machu Picchu Proposal
Summary: Katie helps plan her brother's proposal atop Machu Picchu. When the proposal is ruined by spontaneous Chef Carlos, Katie enlists Carlos to help her find the most romantic spot in all of Peru.

Title: Duck
Summary: An aging widower (Philip Baker Hall) and a duck that thinks of him as its mother encounter helpful and hostile characters as they search for a place and a reason to live.

Title: 15: The Movie
Summary: Five disaffected teenagers rebel against society while roaming the streets of Singapore.

Title: Alpha Gang
Summary: The Alpha Gang are alien invaders sent on a mission to conquer Earth. Disguised in human form, armed and dangerous, and clad in 1950's leather biker get-up, they show no mercy... until they catch the most toxic, contagious human disease of all: emotion.
Producer: Nathan Zellner, David Zellner, Coco Francini, Cate Blanchett, Ryan Zacarias, Gina Gammell, Mary Aloe, Andrea Bucko, Joshua Harris
Production Co: Zellner Bros., Dirty Films, Fat City, Felix Culpa

Title: Granny
Summary: A nostalgic snapshot of a warm night in a Georgian town.

Title: The Snowball on a Sunny Day
WHAM! 10 Days in China
Summary: In 1985, WHAM! made history as the first Western pop act to perform in communist China. George Michael and Andrew Ridgeley's concerts in Beijing and Guangzhou were a cultural milestone -- East meets West, music meets politics. Now, newly restored footage reveals the untold story of the iconic tour that helped launch WHAM! to global superstardom.

Title: Starlight: A Musical Movie
Summary: A local developer (William Hickey) threatens a summer camp for young performing artists in the Catskills of New York.

Title: Mirrors
Summary: A woman (Kitty Winn) loses a husband, gains a doctor (Peter Donat) and has voodoo visions in New Orleans.
Producer: John T. Parker, Stirling W. Smith

Title: Stormbound
Summary: Step inside the eye of the storm. Stormbound thrusts audiences into the heart of the world's most powerful hurricanes with breathtaking, never-before-seen footage captured from within. As wind, water, and land collide, the film follows storm chaser Jeff Gammons, who for more than thirty years has pushed closer than anyone else to document every major hurricane to strike the United States. Now tested by a near fatal disease, Gammons continues his pursuit--revealing the personal cost of chasing nature at its most extreme and the larger environmental forces shaping our world. Stormbound is a high-stakes, immersive experience that places audiences face-to-face with nature at its most powerful.
Producer: Trevor Jones, Adam McKay, Todd Schulman, John Turner

Title: Less of a Stranger
Summary: The leader of Polish rock band Lady Pank, Jan Borysewicz, shapes a generation with his music - as a string of family tragedies shapes him.

Title: Sasquatch Within
Summary: Two assassins wake up trapped in an apartment with an hour to kill each other. As paranoia rises, a legend forces them to confront the monster within.

Title: Sentient
Summary: A thought-provoking exploration into the world of laboratory research on animals examined through the vulnerable confessions and complex emotions of scientific experts on both sides of the debate. Following the story of Dr. Lisa Jones Engel, a primatologist turned animal welfare advocate, it asks 'Can we still justify animal testing in the name of science?'

Title: Ah Girl
Summary: Singapore, 1994: Ah Girl is a precocious 7-year-old just starting primary school. Since her parents separated, she lives in a small flat with her boyish younger sister, Ah Tian (5), her taciturn Dad who works night shifts, and her irritable Grandmother who is in charge of the kids. The kids see their needy and unreliable Mum on weekends when she spoils them with food and toys. One night, Mum asks Ah Girl to choose to live with her, and although she wants to please Mum, Ah Girl struggles with this huge decision. She will have to leave her father and sister once Mum gets a new house. Ah Girl becomes increasingly aware that her family life is not normal, and feels out of place at school. Over the course of the year, life continues for this fragmented family: Mum and Dad start new relationships; Ah Girl has fun and gets into trouble; it seems that Ah Tian might go and live elsewhere; accidents happen, money is tight; there are good times and sad times -- but the weight of what will happen in the future hangs over all of them, especially Ah Girl. We journey with Ah Girl, navigating the confusing world of adults as she’s forced to grow up far too quickly.
Producer: Charlyn Ng, Wendy Lie, Ang Geck Geck
Production Co: Aggregate Films, IFA Media, Kusu Films

Title: Partners
Summary: When Axel (Casper Van Dien), a shady wanderer, overhears the scheme of ambitious computer nerd Bob (David Paymer), the two become very unlikely criminal collaborators. Although Bob is the mastermind behind the plan, which hinges on selling top-secret corporate computer codes, Axel muscles his way into the proceedings, much to his brighter acquaintance's chagrin. Things become even more complicated when others, including Axel's ex-girlfriend, Angel (Vanessa Angel), get involved.

Title: The Home
Summary: Years after leaving his small town, a man returns to move his elderly mother, struggling with dementia, to a nursing home.
Director: Mattias J Skoglund, Linda Jildmalm, Jaanus Vahtra

Title: Union County
Summary: Will Poulter and Noah Centineo deliver pitch-perfect performances as brothers Cody and Jack Parsons, each navigating a court-mandated drug rehabilitation program in a pocket of rural Ohio hit hard by the opioid epidemic. Provided with hope for the first time since their struggles began and with the support of a tireless counselor (Annette Deao), the brothers work toward a brighter, sober future. Poulter and Centineo blend seamlessly with a supporting cast composed predominantly of non-professional actors as they share their actual experiences, pain, and optimism as they, themselves, navigate the program. Ohio-born filmmaker Adam Meeks creates a film imbued with realism for an honest, compassionate portrait of a battle being fought across America and the solidarity that flowers on its front lines.
Producer: Brad Becker-Parton, Martha Gregory, Stephanie Roush, Faye Tsakas, Sean Weiner, Tim Headington, Theresa Steele Page, Ellyn Daniels, Will O'Connor, Will Poulter

Title: The 3 Killer Pigs
Summary: A desperate farmer resorts to the unthinkable to reclaim his livestock. A blood pact unleashes killer pigs returning to their nightmare's genesis. The farmhouse and inhabitants are shrouded in darkness when the three piggies come home.
Production Co: Church Hill Productions, AZ Pure, Shake the Tree Productions

Title: That Friend
Summary: Paul--"THAT FRIEND" who turns one drink into a full-blown bender--invades his best friend Henry's romantic weekend with his new girlfriend Penny, only to unleash chaos when his drug-laced cigarettes disappear into a stranger's hands.

Title: The Napa Boys
Summary: In this fourth chapter of the hit comedy franchise THE NAPA BOYS, Jack Jr. (Nick Corirossi), his reluctant co-captain Miles Jr. (Armen Weitzman), and the rest of the Napa Boys gang are back for one more wine-sloshed journey into the unknown. With a mission set forth by the mysterious "Sommelier," they are joined this time by Puck, a bright young podcaster and the Napa Boys' biggest fan, as the group embarks on the adventure of a lifetime. Featuring Sarah Ramos, Mike Mitchell, Chloe Cherry, Vanessa Chester, Paul Rust, Jamar Neighbors, Nelson Franklin, David Wain, Ray Wise, Riki Lindhome, Natasha Leggero, Ivy Wolk and Beth Dover, THE NAPA BOYS enlists a hilarious ensemble of alt-comedians to hop in the Wine Wagon™ for the new installment in this historic (made-up) franchise.
Producer: Armen Weitzman, Mike Rosenstein, Erin Owens

Title: Tilly
Summary: A girl and her father discover a monster in her bedroom.

Title: Mouth of the Wolf: Amanda Knox Returns to Italy
Summary: Amanda Knox, wrongly convicted of murder, returns to Italy to confront her prosecutor.

Title: Sin Eater
Summary: Inspired by the horrifying Sin Eater folklore, the creepy thriller of the same name follows Christine (Jessie Nerud, She Walks The Woods) a young woman who is on the run from her shadowy past. After suffering a terrifying injury, she finds herself alone and stranded in a remote town harboring a dark secret. As she tries to recuperate, she slowly begins to discover an intense, bizarre religious phenomena occurring around her. With no one to trust and her time running out, Christine realizes that she will have to fight her inner demons as well as the actual demons who are trying to take her soul in order to make it out alive.
Producer: Carmelo Chimera, Judy Fox, José Gras, Jason Potter
Production Co: Blood Brothers Productions, Cult Classic Horror

Title: Medora: Empress of the Badlands
Summary: In 1883 Dakota Territory, the Marquis de Mores and wife Medora arrive to build a home, town, and meat empire, facing hostility from ranchers, beef trusts, and violent locals determined to drive them out.
Producer: Daniel Bielinski, Dave Diebel, Carson Nordgaard, Rachel Morrison

Title: Spenser: Ceremony
Summary: Boston private eye Spenser (Robert Urich) and his friends (Barbara Williams, Avery Brooks) try to save a teenager from prostitution and pornography.

Title: Kat Crime: Tales of the Occult
Summary: An aspiring true-crime YouTuber investigating an occult-linked disappearance gains exclusive access to a reclusive witch coven -- only to discover that belief itself may be the most dangerous weapon of all.

Title: The Violinist
Summary: A woman perpetually plays the violin to merge into her dark world.

Title: Bountiful
Summary: Retired gunfighter Tash Beckett finds a home in the town of Bountiful, but soon the past comes calling. A Western about redemption, sacrifice, and doing what is right.

Title: Dernsie: The Amazing Life of Bruce Dern
Summary: Tireless, uncompromising, and one of the last living legends of his generation, Bruce Dern is an actor whose fearlessness and radical lack of vanity took him places other actors simply wouldn't go. A devoted long-distance runner, Dern has always understood something most people learn too late: endurance is a discipline. He ran through the golden age - directed by Alfred Hitchcock and Hal Ashby, holding his own opposite John Wayne, Bette Davis, and Jack Nicholson. He ran through the lean years. And he kept running until the work caught up with him again - outlasting the very industry that defined him.
Producer: Mike Mendez, Benjamin Epstein, Thomas Verrette, Adam F. Goldberg

Title: Coin
Summary: A young man relies on a coin to make decisions.

Title: Best Friends
Summary: For years, screenwriting team Richard Babson (Burt Reynolds) and Paula McCullen (Goldie Hawn) have built a successful Hollywood career while managing to live harmoniously together. After finishing their latest script, Babson uses the euphoria to convince McCullen to take the leap into marriage. However, when the newlywed couple travels back east to meet their respective in-laws, the pitfalls of marriage begin to surface. Unprepared, Babson and McCullen struggle with the changing dynamics.
Production Co: Warner Brothers/Seven Arts, Major Studio Partners

Title: Falling
Summary: Paul struggles with depression and suicidal thoughts.

Title: Samurai Vengeance
Summary: On a snowy night at Kobiki-cho's Morita-za theater, young Kikunosuke avenges his father's death before witnesses. Eighteen months later, samurai Soichiro arrives claiming family ties, seeking details. His questions uncover a hidden truth.

Title: Evolver 62
Summary: Pulling riches from his extraordinary archive, Lewisohn zips through a galaxy of real lives and times, weaving curated artefacts into an entertaining narrative. He takes the camera out of the theatre and onto the streets of Liverpool and London, to the very places where it happened. A compelling, surprising and unmissable treat, "Evolver 62" delivers unique viewing for all Beatles fans, all music fans, and anyone curious about important moments in our still-recent past.

Title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
Summary: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald traces the life and career of the stand-up and Saturday Night Live legend, from his rise as the deadpan anchor of “Weekend Update” to his enduring legacy as a comedian’s comedian — a master of absurd, dry, and unexpected humor. Built from archival footage, personal photos, and rare home videos contributed by fans and friends, the documentary lets Norm tell his own story in his own voice.
Producer: Judd Apatow, Amanda Rohlke, Ross M. Dinerstein

Title: Small Talk
Summary: A phone sex worker's career takes a frightening turn as her unpleasant clients begin dying in bizarre ways.

Title: Skintown
Summary: 1994. As northern Ireland takes its first steps towards peace, best mates Vinny and Jonty are about to jump start their futures with the most reckless trip of their lives.

Title: Elephants in the Fog
Summary: In a small Nepalese village nestled in the heart of a forest populated by wild elephants, Pirati is the matriarch of a Kinnar community. She dreams of escaping to a “normal” life with the man she is in love with. But when one of her daughters disappears, she must investigate and choose between love and responsibility to her community.

Title: Rédemptions
Summary: Follows a retired hitman forced to return to Montreal to commit two murders.
Production Co: Black Mask Productions, Christal Films Productions, Christal Films, Tarantula Belgique, Rumble Fish, Dream Rokh

Title: Cactus
Summary: Colo (Isabelle Huppert), a young woman in a failing marriage, is involved in an accident and loses sight in one of her eyes. Doctors give her the option of retaining her good eye, which could continue to function. On the other hand, it could slip into "sympathetic blindness," leaving her completely without sight. Then, she meets and falls in love with Robert (Robert Menzies), a blind doctor, and contemplates sacrificing her good eye in order to better understand his world.

Title: Hamilton House
Summary: Hamilton House is a Halloween-set comedy following a group of young actors who live together in a cramped New York City basement apartment. When the wide-eyed Zach learns that a legendary horror film director is moving into their neighborhood, he convinces his girlfriend and other roommates to turn their home into a haunted house to get the filmmaker's attention. But as Halloween grows closer, Zach's plans begin to unravel, risking much more than his big break.
Producer: Jordan Rowe, Greg Contaldi, Julianne Mason

Title: Fantasy Life
Summary: An anxious law school dropout (Matthew Shear) stumbles into a job babysitting his psychiatrist's three granddaughters and falls for the girls' mother (Amanda Peet), an actress in a rocky marriage. A smart, New York-set romantic comedy co-starring Alessandro Nivola, Judd Hirsch, Bob Balaban, Andrea Martin, Zosia Mamet, and Holland Taylor. Winner of the SXSW Narrative Feature Audience Award.
Producer: Charlie Alderman, Christopher Dodds, Amanda Peet, Phil Keefe, Emily McCann Lesser, David Bernon, Sam Slater
Production Co: Prospect Avenue, Burn Later Productions, Made By Limbo, AC3 Media, Charlie's Production Company

Title: Collapse
Summary: A man seeks revenge after being buried alive and left for dead.

Title: Ice Beast
Summary: When a young girl goes out to search for her missing grandfather, the cold is not the only thing she has to survive. As night falls and the snow closes in, she begins to realize she is not alone and whatever is out there has been waiting.

Title: I Remember
Summary: Jews hide in small towns in Poland to escape Nazi persecution.

Title: No Brainer
Summary: Radio host Dave Rickards receives an offer to move to satellite radio as long as he dumps his sidekick.

Title: Violette
Summary: Teenage Violette Nozière (Isabelle Huppert) poisons her parents (Stéphane Audran, Jean Carmet) to support her lover in 1930s Paris.
Screenwriter: Odile Barski, Herve Bromberger, Frédéric Grendel, Jean-Marie Fitère

Title: Atonement
Summary: This sweeping English drama, based on the book by Ian McEwan, follows the lives of young lovers Cecilia Tallis and Robbie Turner. When the couple are torn apart by a lie constructed by Cecilia's jealous younger sister, Briony, all three of them must deal with the consequences. Robbie is the hardest hit, since Briony's deception results in his imprisonment, but hope for Cecilia and her beau increases when their paths cross during World War II.
Producer: Tim Bevan, Eric Fellner, Paul Webster
Production Co: Relativity Media, StudioCanal, Working Title Films, Universal Pictures

Title: Dust
Summary: Magda is the unwed daughter of a white South African farmer. Spending much of her time looking after her father, Magda leads an uneventful and isolated life, largely avoiding other people. However, that changes when Magda discovers that her father has been having an affair with one of the farm's African workers. Unable to handle the revelation that her dad has a mistress, Magda takes surprisingly drastic and violent action.

Title: Tony Odyssey
Summary: After robbing the bar where he works, Tony and his best friend Ivy steal a hallucinogenic drug that sends them on a surreal Brazilian odyssey--where crime, faith, and illusion collide in a search for God.
Producer: Thales Banzai, Camila Cornelsen, Mario Peixoto

Title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
Summary: What began as a cult sex-positive NYC cable access show turned into a national voice for AIDS awareness and free speech. Robin Byrd's unapologetic show championed sexual freedom, queer visibility, and safe sex from the late 1970-90s, serving as both a community lifeline and a target of a national censorship battle that took her to the Supreme Court and cemented her as a First Amendment fighter. Now approaching 70--and still the longest-running host on cable TV--Robin confronts her place in the history she created, while caring for the husband her viewers never knew existed.
Producer: Sarah Jessica Parker, Alison Benson, Caroline Waterlow, Stephanie Schwam, Jyllian Gunther
Production Co: HBO Documentary Films, Pretty Matches Productions

Title: Fission
Summary: A man sees himself as graffiti on the wall.

Title: Bulles
Summary: A voice to autistic teenagers who invite us into their imaginary worlds. Through their creations, the film offers an illuminating look at difference and reveals rich universes far removed from the clichés associated with the diagnosis.

Title: Nazar
Summary: Suddenly clairvoyant, pop singer Divya Varma (Meera) is having visions of terrible crimes before they happen. So when she learns that there's a serial killer stalking Mumbai, India, she tells the police. Investigators Rohan Sethi (Ashmit Patel) and Sujata Deshmukh (Koel Purie) hear her out, though they're more focused on the tangible facts of murders that have already occurred. Yet when Divya continues to foresee the deaths of local waitresses, the investigation heads in a different direction.

Title: Still Hope
Summary: Hope, a teenager from a tight-knit community, finds herself in danger when the person she believes to be a new friend proves unsafe. Taken from all she knows, Hope is forced into sex trafficking and stripped of her identity. After finding freedom from her captors, Hope discovers that survival is only the first step. Inspired by true stories, Hope's journey is a powerful illustration of the courage it takes to walk the complex path of recovery.

Title: Broken English
Summary: Nora Wilder (Parker Posey), a single woman, is heading deep into the doldrums as a result of disappointments in her professional and personal lives. A series of disastrous dates convinces her that love will always elude her. At a co-worker's party, she meets Julien (Melvil Poupaud), a young man from Paris, who sweeps her off her feet and invites her to France with him. Nora refuses, then wonders if she has made the biggest mistake of her life.
Producer: Andrew Fierberg, Jason Kliot, Joana Vicente
Production Co: Vox3 Films, Backup Media, HDNet Films, Phantom Film

Title: See Me
Summary: South African orphans and volunteers take part in a photo contest that's designed to spread awareness of the effects of HIV/AIDS on children.

Title: Fluke
Summary: Workaholic Thomas P. Johnson (Matthew Modine) has achieved professional success at the expense of his family life, having neglected his wife, Carol (Nancy Travis), and son, Brian (Max Pomeranc). After Johnson wrecks his car in a dangerous street race with co-worker Jeff Newman (Eric Stoltz), he finds himself watching his own funeral. Returning to Earth as a dog, Johnson finds his family and struggles to have a positive influence on their lives -- in spite of his canine form.

Title: The Night
Summary: A man searches the past to learn about his father.

Title: Abuela
Summary: The story of a grandma who lives alone, knits and recalls old memories.

Title: Chrysalis
Summary: A futuristic lawman's (Albert Dupontel) search for a killer leads him to a mysterious surgeon.

Title: Double Double Trouble
Summary: As old wounds and buried resentments resurface, Drea gets pulled into a dangerous psychological battle with her twin sister -- one that blurs identity, fractures reality, and leads to deadly consequences.

Title: Souvenir
Summary: An ex-Nazi (Christopher Plummer) returns with his daughter (Catherine Hicks) 40 years later to the French village where he was during the war.

Title: Just Look Up
Summary:
JUST LOOK UP follows Michael Greenberg, a brazen visionary and founder of Climate
Defiance, a disruptive youth movement. In the tradition of Gandhi's Satyagraha, the Civil Rights Movement, and ACT UP, they use radical nonviolent direct action to jolt society awake, calling out Big Oil, corporate CEOs, and the politicians who enable them. The film charts a motley, idealistic crew improvising, failing, regrouping, and pushing on to protect the planet. As they press forward, the film's propulsive soundtrack is not background but fuel, with Chappell Roan, Doechii, and Billie Eilish pushing the pace and sharpening the stakes for a generation with no room to fail.
Producer: Natja Noviani Rosner, Signe Byrge Sørensen
Production Co: Guest House Productions, Final Cut for Real

Title: Young Blood
Summary: A frontier Robin Hood (Bob Steele) helps a foreign actress shunned by other women.

Title: Love Story
Summary: When wealthy Harvard University law student Oliver Barrett IV meets Jenny Cavilleri, a middle-class girl who is studying music at Radcliffe College, it's love at first sight. Despite the protests of Oliver's father, the young couple marry. Oliver finds a job at a legal firm in New York City, but their happy life comes crashing down when it's discovered that Jenny has a terminal illness. Together, they try to cope with the situation as best they can.

Title: The Sheriffs of Savage Wells
Summary: Savage Wells needs a sheriff. Paisley Bell aims to prove herself while renowned lawman Cade O'Brien also seeks the job. The rival candidates clash and banter as unexpected feelings develop. When criminals threaten the town, they must unite.

Title: False Start
Summary: A track star (Harrison Butler) seeks help from a therapist (Kevin Kolack) after a hazing incident.

Title: Resurrection
Summary: Three friends look for a girl who went missing from a haunted area in the outskirts of a town. It is only a matter of time before they experience the horror that befell her.

Title: Amoeba
Summary: 16-year-old Choo befriends 3 rebellious classmates in their elite all-girls Chinese school. Their urge to resist authoritarian teachers and school doctrines drives them to discover the erased stories of mythical gangsters that ruled the streets of colonial Singapore. They decide to form their own gang. But how do you form a gang in modern Singapore, where even chewing gum is illegal?
Production Co: Akanga Film Asia, Volya Films, Les Films d'Antoine, Mararía Films, Widelog Office

Title: Ramani Kalyanam
Producer: Vijay Adireddy, Manoj Chinthireddy, Srinath Pasupuleti

Title: The Room Below
Summary: Haunted by the loss of her son, a mother sees a second chance in a boy who enters her life at the perfect moment. But as the Creature hidden within her home grows more dangerous and difficult to control, a retired detective investigating a missing child begins unraveling a web of secrets that leads straight to her door, forcing a deadly confrontation with the truth.
Producer: Jim Robison, Chris Chard, Ty Linegar

Title: Dau
Summary: A fearless tour guide embarks on a daring mission to rescue her 16-year-old sister from the clutches of ruthless human traffickers.

Title: Lacuna
Summary: A man (Shawn Yue) and a woman (Jingchu Zhang) wake up next to each other without any recollection of how it happened.

Title: Kings
Summary: Friends who immigrated to London years ago reunite for a comrade's wake.

Title: Sanctus House
Director: Kenyon T. Henry, Matthew B. Lawrence

Title: The Serpent's Skin
Summary: After escaping her transphobic hometown, Anna meets goth tattoo artist Gen. They bond over shared supernatural abilities, but Gen's tattoo work accidentally conjures a demon before their romance can bloom.
Screenwriter: Benjamin Pahl Robinson, Alice Maio Mackay
Production Co: Dark Star Pictures, One Manner Productions

Title: Low Expectations
Summary: At the height of her music career, Maja falls apart and has to step away from her ambitions. Depressed and broke, she moves back home with her mother and works part-time at a local high school. Far from the spotlight, wrapped in everyday kindness, she slowly finds her way back to life.

Title: Bight
Summary: Two couples' daring foray into open relationships leads them down a tumultuous path of jealousy, betrayal, and heartbreak.
Producer: Mark Hapka, Cameron Cowperthwaite, Maiara Walsh, Stephen Moffatt, Yori X
Production Co: White Room Productions, 80 Proof Pictures, Inspired Ink Productions

Title: Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders
Summary: "Mineshaft: The Cruising Murders" peels back the layers of controversy surrounding the making of the 1980 thriller, "Cruising." Directed by William Friedkin, the film triggered fierce protests from the LGBTQ+ community for its portrayal of a serial killer targeting gay men in New York's leather bars. Friedkin drew inspiration from the brutal murder of Variety reporter Addison Verrill, blurring the boundaries between cinematic fiction and real-life tragedy.

Title: Vanished in an Instant
Summary: Megan's teenage daughter, Whitney, disappears after their car breaks down at a gas station. As a shadowy figure traps Whitney in a deadly game of survival, Megan scrambles to uncover the truth before she's lost forever.

Title: Love Lessons
Summary: Sunny (Patty Duke) and Mick (Ronny Cox) are a married couple in their 50s looking forward to retiring early and sailing around the world. They must reconsider their plans, however, when Sonya finds out she's pregnant. Unsure how to proceed, they seek advice from various friends and family members. Sonya grows more convinced she should have the baby, while Mick seems inclined to set sail. The two will soon discover if their differences are irreconcilable.
Screenwriter: Susan Arnout Smith, Judith Feldman, Sarah Woodside Gallagher

Title: Rodeo
Summary: Shot in four days during the 1968 National Rodeo Finals in Oklahoma City, Okla., cowboys hold their own against stiff competition with the hopes of becoming the champion. Each cowboy prepares to confront a 2,800 pound bull.

Title: Once Upon a Time
Summary: Bai Qian, a goddess and monarch from the Heavenly Realms, is sent to the mortal world to undergo a trial to become a High Goddess. There, she meets Ye Hua, with whom she falls in love.

Title: Mother Tongue
Summary: A man who battled his entire life to save his culture and his language is dismayed when his own grandchildren refuse to learn their mother tongue.

Title: Captain
Summary: The captain of a fishing boat from a remote Innu reserve sets out on a journey across Quebec in the hope of finding his missing daughter.

Title: The Orphan
Summary: A homeless pregnant woman searches for a place to stay with the man who impregnated her. She is distraught to find out that he has left the country indefinitely, and is at a loss for where to go next.

Title: Almost Winter
Summary: An elderly professor's assistant must deal with his ailing memory while justifying his right to retain tenure to the college's dean.

Title: Early Bird
Summary: The dawn of a commercial radio station.

Title: Crocodile Tears
Summary: Johan, on the cusp of manhood, lives alone with his Mama on a crocodile farm in West Java. Mother and son live in voluntary exile with only a white crocodile as their confidant. Their life of isolation is disrupted when Johan falls for a girl in town, Arumi, setting off a chain of events that threatens the delicate balance of their lives. As the fabric of their world unravels, Mama's opposition manifests in increasingly bizarre ways....
Producer: Mandy Marahimin, Anthony Chen, Claire Lajoumard, Yi Peng Teoh, Christophe Lafont, Harry Flöter, Jörg Siepmann

Title: Uncle Roy
Summary: "Uncle Roy" is a poignant exploration of family, memory, and artistic legacy. Filmmaker Keri Pickett delves into the life of her 93-year-old uncle, Roy Blakey, a trailblazer in theatrical ice skating and gay male photography. Their deep bond, as the last members of their family tree, is revealed through decades of recent and archival footage. Roy's story spans from the Depression-era to the present, beginning with his career in 1950s and 60s ice shows, finding an authentic gay life in the world of touring performances. He became a celebrated photographer in 1970s New York, as a second career, capturing stars like Debbie Allen, Shirley MacLaine, and Divine. He pioneered contemporary male nude photography with his groundbreaking book, HE (1972). Inspired by Roy, Keri followed in his footsteps, becoming a photographer and strengthening their lifelong connection. The film showcases Roy's extensive ice-skating memorabilia collection--over 44,000 items, spanning a century of dancing on ice. When Roy suffers a life-threatening seizure and the onset of dementia, Keri becomes his primary caregiver. As his memories fade, she races to fulfill his final wish: securing a home for his unparalleled and far-reaching archives. On Roy's 94th birthday, only a month before his passing, the Tretter Collection at the University of Minnesota agreed to preserve both his photography and skating memorabilia, ensuring his contributions are preserved along with all their queer significance. In capturing Roy's final chapter, Keri's journey highlights the power of art, love, and legacy, preserving the story of a vibrant artist whose impact will endure.

Pets mysteriously die, the baby will not stop crying, and Joshua develops an interest in mummification. The incidents may be coincidental, or Joshua's intelligence masks an extremely evil heart.

Title: Sour Minnows
Summary: Two friends stumble upon an unusual sight: six men sensually licking the pavement on an empty LA street. For Ricky, this moment ruptures something. As his reality grows porous, and his memories begin to slip and slide, he finds himself in contact with "The Yellow Thing," an entity that wears people like costumes. As Ricky adapts to his expanding worldview, a delirious new logic takes hold.
Producer: Harrison Atkins, Sarah Winshall, Allison Bunce, Kate Banford, Mel Barnes, Suzanna Son, Anne Gormely

Title: Silent Rebellion
Summary: 15-year-old Emma, pregnant after a rape, defies her repressive rural Protestant community to carve a path of self-determination, transforming trauma into a catalyst for emancipation while confronting the moral hypocrisy of the village and the specter of World War II around her.
Producer: Elena Tatti, Nicolas Wittwer, Julie Esparbes, Emmanuelle Latourrette, Fabrice Préel-Cléach

Title: Strays
Summary: A criminal (Vin Diesel) tries to change his ways after falling in love.

Title: Carousel
Summary: Based on the lauded Rodgers and Hammerstein stage musical, this film follows the romance of Billy Bigelow (Gordon MacRae), a charming carousel barker, and Julie Jordan (Shirley Jones), a pretty worker from a nearby mill. When the attractive young couple gets married, they also both find themselves unemployed, which puts a strain on their relationship. When Billy finds out that Julie is pregnant, he resorts to extreme measures to get money, a decision that leads to tragedy.

Title: Street Smart
Summary: Jonathan Fisher (Christopher Reeve) is a reporter struggling to keep his job at a magazine. Assigned to write a real-life prostitution exposé, he fails to gain information from his subjects and decides to make up his own story about a pimp. The piece revives his career, but his fictional character turns out to be strangely similar to Fast Black (Morgan Freeman), an actual pimp, who is outraged and demands that Jonathan spill his sources. When the police get involved, matters get even uglier.

Title: The End
Summary: After discovering that he has only months to live, Wendell Lawson tries to settle issues with his family, including his ex-wife. When he gets little empathy or even attention from his relatives, he becomes distraught and sets out to kill himself. Following many unsuccessful suicide attempts, Lawson winds up in a mental hospital, where he meets deranged fellow patient Marlon Borunki, who is quite eager to help his new friend end his life.

Title: You Can't Leave
Summary: A young man (Spencer Boldman) searches for answers behind his sister’s mysterious disappearance. His journey leads him and a group of friends, including Olivia (Paola Andino), deep into a remote forest where they become trapped in a supernatural prison. Hunted by shadowy entities, the group is forced to confront both physical and psychological terror as they struggle to escape.
Producer: Robert Paschall Jr., Gopal Bala, Austin Taylor, Northrup Loyd

Title: The Furious: Pertaruhan Maruah
Summary: Brothers Firdaus and Hakim reunite to fight a brash YouTuber-boxer named Danial after he publicly insults their late father and boxing legend, Hameed.

Title: Manhunt
Summary: Hunters stalk a group of unwitting friends in a remote forest in Europe.

Title: Finnegan's Foursome
Summary: Two rival brothers and their adult children head to Ireland to honor their late father's final wish: scattering his ashes on the coastal golf course he adored. What starts as a clash of egos, old grudges, and comic misadventures becomes a week of unlikely bonding and hard-won warmth. Along the way, the Finnegans learn that family--like golf--takes patience, forgiveness, and a willingness to play through the rough.
Producer: Ellen H. Schwartz, Aaron Lubin, Edward Burns
Production Co: Wild Atlantic Pictures, Marlboro Road Gang Productions

Title: Mastermind
Summary: A bumbling Asian detective is assigned to protect an experimental robot in this spoof of Charlie Chan mysteries.

Title: Anchors Aweigh

The two men at first plan to use their layover as an opportunity to relax, but they soon find themselves in a complicated web of comic secrets. When the two buddies find a runaway boy and return him to his fame-hungry Aunt Susan (Kathryn Grayson), both men find themselves falling for the wannabe singer, setting off a series of misadventures that unfold in comedy and song.

Title: Ginny Wedss Sunny 2

Honey thinks she's hit the jackpot when she meets a hotshot director (David Moscow) who casts her in one of his music videos. But, when he starts demanding sexual favors from her, Honey makes a decision that will change her life.
Production Co: Universal Pictures, NuAmerica Entertainment, Marc Platt Productions

Title: Night Terror
Summary: A housewife (Valerie Harper) flees from a policeman's killer (Richard Romanus) on the road between Phoenix and Denver.

Title: Harvest
Summary: A man (Azaniah) dreams of leaving a Caribbean island and sailing to Martinique.

Title: Royally Screwed
Summary: When duty calls and expectations rise, one unexpected connection changes everything. Royally Screwed is a romance with heart, wit, and undeniable chemistry - where falling in love was never part of the plan.

Title: The Curse
Summary: A woman leaves to meet her older lover, but when a boy catches her, she just wants to go home.

Title: The Cowboy

Title: Phillip Philadelphia
Summary: Phillip is an English screenwriter with a torrid past who flees to a Gold Coast motel with his younger lover to finish his new script. But tensions flare as the past re-emerges, and the violent allure of the motel's other inhabitants drive Phillip to action.

Summary: Shangguan Tianyi uncovers secrets and intrigue after he's entrusted to rescue a boy named Ziming from the Black Shadow Sect.

Summary: Dutch (Spencer Tracy) is a fisherman, and Hattie (Jean Harlow) works at the cannery in a small town on the California coast. The two get married, but Dutch's union activities backfire and the couple are soon living in poverty. Angry and ashamed, Dutch abandons Hattie, and she takes up with Nick (Joseph Calleia), a boss at the factory. But Hattie's love for Dutch never dies, and they both struggle to overcome their fiery personalities so they can reconcile.
Screenwriter: Frances Marion, H. W. Hanemann, Anita Loos

Title: Sorekara
Summary: In the changing Tokyo of 1909, businessman's son Daisuke (Yusaku Matsuda) lives apart from his family in a world of books and art. Disdaining modernization and sheltered from financial worries, Daisuke's cloistered life is shaken up when old friend Hiroaka (Kaoru Kobayashi) and his wife Michiyo (Miwako Fujitani) return. Daisuke never declared his love for Michiyo, stepping aside for his friend. With Hiroaka in financial trouble and Michiyo miserable, will Daisuke flout society to steal her away?

Title: Sunrise
Summary: Bored with his wife (Janet Gaynor), their baby and the dull routine of farm life, a farmer (George O'Brien) falls under the spell of a flirtatious city girl (Margaret Livingston) who convinces him to drown his wife so they can escape together. When his wife becomes suspicious of his plan and runs away to the city, the farmer pursues her, slowly regaining her trust as the two rediscover their love for each other in this award-winning silent classic.

Title: The Education of Jane Cumming

Their lives are changed forever when a wealthy aristocrat enrols her "illegitimate" 15-year-old grandchild from India. The teachers struggle to integrate the girl who remains an outsider among her classmates. Miss Pirie and Miss Woods are brought closer to Jane Cumming when her grandmother insists they look after her over the summer. Private and professional lines blur, affection between them grows and they start to form an unlikely family. Tensions rise as the new term begins. The teachers are overwhelmed with the girl's increasing desire for closeness and their own changing relationship. As Jane Cumming begins to feel excluded from her new family, she demands to be taken home to her grandmother. An accusation follows which leaves the teacher's fighting for their lives, resulting in a legal battle that would last a decade and scandalize the Scottish establishment. Based on true events.

Title: Murder in the Highland Manor
Summary: Kate takes a job as a live-in tutor at a secluded Scottish estate for a mother and daughter who have survived domestic abuse. She soon becomes embroiled in the family's deadly secrets when she discovers the previous au pair mysteriously disappeared.
Producer: Ryan Dewar, Rachel Flynn, Brooke Williams
Production Co: Triventure Films , Triventure Films (Mansion Mystery), Interabang Productions

Title: Love on the Amazon
Summary: Claire travels to Brazil and hires Danny, a riverboat captain, to help her deliver an important message for her sister Amelia, a marine biologist studying pink dolphins on the Amazon River.

Title: Come with Me

Title: Pradhama Drishtya Kuttakkar
Summary: A woman constable joins the police force through appointment after the death of her husband.

Title: Fault

Producer: Leigh Ann Bellamy, Barbara Bell, Brent Nurse
Production Co: Bnice Films, CuriousYou Productions, Shiny Object Creative

Title: Death Name
Summary: A young Korean American woman yearns to learn more about her heritage, not knowing the further she digs, the more she reawakens a deadly family curse.

Title: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
Summary: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.
Production Co: Bob Bain Productions, Day Zero Productions

Title: The House
Summary: With all of the comings and goings as well as the unions and separations, the home is the center of everyday routine and relationships.

Title: Frankie, Maniac Woman
Summary:
Battling against the legacy of childhood trauma, internalized misogyny,
and the image-obsessed fat shaming of the LA music business, aspiring singer-songwriter Frankie Ramirez ﬁnally snaps, with bloody results.
Production Co: Two Witches Films, The Rancon Company

Title: Lust
Summary: A famous crime writer begins to experience strange events after she is brutally attacked by a crazed fan.
Producer: Severin Eskeland, Reinert Horneland, Jimmi Salomonsen

Title: Super Nature
Summary: A global love letter to nature, SUPER NATURE is an immersive exploration of our world today, filmed exclusively on the original home movie format, Super 8. Led by filmmaker Ed Sayers, we’re invited on a spellbinding journey of togetherness with our fellow dwellers on earth - human and non-human - as people embrace beauty, abundance and loss. Embracing all we have, and all we have to lose, SUPER NATURE proposes a new way of seeing.
Production Co: Seven Productions, Grasp The Nettle Films

Title: Summer Sparks
Summary: "Summer Sparks" welcomes all to Camp Evergreen, where a summer cook-off means laughter, connection, and a little romance. Single father Adam (Jesse Metcalfe) arrives with his competitive son and finds himself swept up in challenges-and joys. He meets Monica (Kathryn Davis), a single mom returning to her childhood camp to share its magic with her own kids. As they navigate cooking mishaps and heartfelt moments, their growing connection adds an extra spark to an already unforgettable summer.
Production Co: Champlain Media, Roku Originals, Studio TF1 America

Title: Phoenix Jones: The Rise and Fall of a Real Life Superhero
Producer: Claire Chubbuck, Marlowe Blue, Duncan Dickerson

Summary: A man experiences a ghostly encounter with a message of compassion.

Title: Dear Diary
Summary: Filmmaker Nanni Moretti (Nanni Moretti) goes on three disparate journeys. First, he rides through Rome on a scooter, musing on cinema, and has a chance encounter with actress Jennifer Beals (Jennifer Beals). Next, he and his friend, Gerardo (Renato Carpentieri), tour a number of islands searching for a peaceful place to write a screenplay. And finally, Moretti, hampered by a nagging skin rash, goes from doctor to doctor looking for the right diagnosis, which may or may not turn out to be severe.
Producer: Nella Banfi, Angelo Barbagallo, Nanni Moretti
Production Co: Le Studio Canal +, Banfilm, La Sept Cinema, Sacher Film, RAI Radiotelevisione Italiana

Title: Ueck
Summary: Over a career that spanned more than six decades, Bob Uecker became one of the most recognizable and beloved voices in American sports. Known for his razor-sharp wit and relentless self-deprecating humor, Uecker transformed a modest career as a Major League backup catcher into an unlikely second act as a national comedian, actor, and legendary broadcaster. To generations of fans, he was simply "Mr. Baseball." Filmed over the final three years of his life with remarkable access, this intimate documentary captures Uecker as he reflects on the improbable journey that carried him from the dugouts of Major League Baseball to late-night television, Hollywood, and the broadcast booth of the Milwaukee Brewers -- where his voice became synonymous with summer for fans across the Midwest.​​ Beneath the jokes and tall tales lies a portrait of a uniquely American character whose humility, resilience, and love of the game made him far more than a punchline -- he became a cultural institution.

Title: Water Rites
Summary: Katie and James have the perfect summer planned. A small cabin in the woods, a secluded lake front community, a little time to themselves. But after learning about the town's history and encountering some of the locals.

Title: The Voices of Our Mother
Summary: When a family matriarch falls seriously ill, relatives gather and discover their shared ancestral ties bind them in unexpected ways.

Title: Face/Off
Summary: Obsessed with bringing terrorist Castor Troy (Nicolas Cage) to justice, FBI agent Sean Archer (John Travolta) tracks down Troy, who has boarded a plane in Los Angeles. After the plane crashes and Troy is severely injured, possibly dead, Archer undergoes surgery to remove his face and replace it with Troy's. As Archer tries to use his disguise to elicit information about a bomb from Troy's brother, Troy awakes from a coma and forces the doctor who performed the surgery to give him Archer's face.
Producer: Terence Chang, David Permut, Barrie M. Osborne

Title: Mars
Summary: As they journey toward the red planet, astronauts and robots fall in love.
Producer: Javier Bonafont, Robert Howell, Geoff Marslett, Anish Savjani

Title: Legacy
Summary: A woman faces a complex choice between either giving up her New York City lifestyle or losing her father's business and the continuation of his legacy in the community.

Title: Death
Summary: This surreal arthouse drama depicts the last memories of Sabrina (Marigold Pazar). Her friends, Wendy (Lauren Johnson) and Mazza (Oliver James Damian), and lover Romeo (David Hecimovic) are a part of her life. Things soon get a little... unnerving. It might take more than one watch to fully grasp all the twists and turns of this psychological horror, which blends dreams, reality, fantasy and deception into a Lynchian mesh.

Title: Felt
Summary: A woman (Amy Everson) creates costumed alter egos to cope with past trauma, but they soon begin to turn violent.

Title: No One Leaves
Summary: When Meredith and her husband go to their neighbor's farm for dinner, he introduces them to his visiting niece. But as the evening progresses, Meredith starts to suspect the young woman isn't his niece, but his captive.

Title: Death Boom
Summary: The Baby Boom ends with a bang: over a billion people will die in the next 15 years, and our funeral systems aren't ready for the "Death Boom." As morgues overflow and wallets empty, a broken, billion-dollar industry is exposed. But better options exist. This shocking, eye-opening, and surprisingly uplifting documentary dives deep into the business of death, revealing who's keeping it alive, and why. With unprecedented access and bold voices leading a new movement, Death Boom reclaims the end of life with humanity, sustainability, and just the right dose of dark humor.
Producer: Eli Roth, Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean McKittrick, Phillip Watson, Jennifer Davisson Killoran, Raymond Mansfield

Title: I, Matter
Summary: A college girl living with HIV in Los Angeles struggles with everyday life, relationships and the possibility of death as her health declines.

Title: London
Summary: An unemployed Indian in London teams up with an aimless man, and circumstances lead them to con a visually impaired elderly couple.

Title: Small Talk
Summary: A phone sex worker's career takes a frightening turn as her unpleasant clients begin dying in bizarre ways.

Title: Black Maria
Summary: A rock band experiences a crisis when its sponsor dies, and it leaves only 6 days to make new arrangements of its old songs.

Title: Hekla
Summary: Hekla, a determined Chicago actress, races through auditions, breakups, and self-doubt over the course of one chaotic day, risking her heart and career to claim her voice and step fully into the artist and woman she's meant to be.
Producer: Michael Glover Smith, Elizabeth Stam, Aaron Wertheimer

Title: The Commute
Summary: Examines disparities in travel on both sides of the border.

Title: Shuffle
Summary: Housewife Linda's happy life shatters when her husband Jim dies in an accident. The next day, Jim is fine. The day after, his funeral begins. Through a series of mysterious events, Linda realizes she is living a shuffled week.
Producer: Natsuki Ito, Tatsuya Sumeragi, Yôsuke Miyake, Yuzo Takahashi, Takeshi Moriya

Title: From Inside Out: The Architecture of Peter Zumthor
Summary: Wim Wenders explores the work and philosophy of Pritzker Prize-winning Swiss architect Peter Zumthor in an immersive documentary about the powerful relationship between people and the places they visit, work in or inhabit. Filmed over more than 14 years and captured through cutting-edge 3D cinematography, the film invites audiences to experience Zumthor’s architectural originals through the eyes of visitors, users, inhabitants or craftspeople – allowing them to walk through these spaces themselves. Journeying from intimate private homes to the monumental new David Geffen Galleries at LACMA in Los Angeles, FROM INSIDE OUT reveals Zumthor’s devotion to craftsmanship and materiality, combined with his profound sense of place. Wenders shows that architecture is not simply about buildings, but about how they shape our emotions, memories and understanding of the world. You’ll walk out with a new understanding of what buildings can mean to you.
Producer: Marc Schmidheiny, Christoph Daniel, Karsten Brünig, Wim Wenders

Title: Vanya
Summary: Bullies at an orphanage play a cruel trick on another boy.

Title: Robot Girls
Summary: When a robot girl companion fails to listen to its developer, the developer uses an advanced model to train the robot girl. But when the training turns deadly, the developer finds himself in trouble.

Title: Paper Airplanes
Summary: When Mateo stars experiencing ghostly visions of Enrique, a recently deceased classmate, who is rumored to have killed himself after his parents discovered that he was gay, it opens him up to process his grief and start accepting his own desires.

Title: Darlene Love: I Know Where I've Been
Producer: Mark Selby, Taraji P. Henson, Barry Avrich
Production Co: Melbar Entertainment Group, TPH Entertainment, Loft Entertainment

Title: Meet Me in the Margins
Summary: An acquisitions editor secretly pens a romance novel and develops feelings for her anonymous manuscript editor, who's revealed to be her new VP, leaving her torn between playing it safe and pursuing true love.

Title: Next Door
Summary: Wilted azaleas trigger a feud between a professor (James Woods) and his wife (Kate Capshaw), and a butcher (Randy Quaid) and his wife.
Production Co: Tudor Entertainment, Showtime Networks Inc., Nederlander Television & Film Productions, TriStar Television

Summary: A bold, genre-defying experience that trades pop pageantry for pure artistry. Awe-inspiring vocals, breathtaking choreography, and iconic performances, captured cinematically and soundtracked by an unmatched catalog of hits.

Summary: After witnessing a fatal shootout, three struggling waitresses hide a bag of illicit cash, forcing them into a perilous web of betrayal and survival.

Title: The Eternal Return

Title: Three Housewives and a Body
Summary: A home invasion goes terribly wrong when Jackie, Ella and Lorelai accidentally kill a man whom Jackie's been hiding from. After agreeing to bury the body, guilt starts to eat away at Lorelai -- but she must stick to the pact, or she'll be next.

Summary: High school student Chris Brander (Ryan Reynolds) loves his best friend, Jamie Palamino (Amy Smart). He finally confesses his feelings, but she tells him that she just wants to be friends, and he leaves town in shame. Ten years later, Chris is a successful record executive and involved with self-absorbed pop star Samantha James (Anna Faris). He still pines for Jamie, though, and when his plans to go to Paris for the holidays fall through, he returns to his hometown to try and win her heart.
Producer: Chris Bender, Bill Johnson, Michael Ohoven, J.C. Spink, William Vince
Production Co: Just Friends Productions Inc., Cinerenta, Inferno Distribution, Benderspink

Title: Anomie
Producer: Bhavana, Roy C.J., Adit Prasanna Kumar, Kumar Mangat Pathak, Abhishek Pathak, Bhushan Kumar, Krishan Kumar

Title: Destiny
Summary: A mother fights to give her autistic son a normal education.

Title: The Promise
Summary: When a powerful crime boss kills his mentor, a young gangster who is on the rise goes to war to get revenge.

Title: Four Birds
Summary: After serving time for a crime he didn't commit, Muckmud walks free only to find that home no longer feels like home. His neighborhood has hardened, the rules have changed, and the family he left behind is fractured by pain, distance, and unanswered questions. As old alliances pull him back toward familiar dangers, a new love offers a glimpse of hope and a different future. But redemption isn't easy in a city gripped by rising violence and the constant temptation of drugs. Forced to navigate loyalty, survival, and forgiveness, Muckmud must decide whether to repeat the cycle that almost destroyed him or fight for a life he's never truly been allowed to have. Four Birds is a gritty, emotional story about second chances, identity, and the cost of choosing who you become.

Title: Last Night
Summary: Sky's last night in Washington, D.C., before moving with her boyfriend becomes a whirlwind of emotions when a meeting with a handsome stranger tests her will.

Title: Day One
Summary: Based on true events surrounding the creation of the atomic bomb, this drama follows the complicated relationship between physicist Leo Szilard (Michael Tucker), scientist J. Robert Oppenheimer (David Strathairn) and Gen. Leslie Groves (Brian Dennehy). Assigned to oversee the project, Groves chooses Oppenheimer to build the historic bomb. But, when World War II inspires the government to use the weapon, Szilard reconsiders his opinions about atomic warfare.

Title: Perfect Moment
Summary: Filmmaker Nicholas Hondrogen asks people, from celebrities to the homeless, to recall profound events.

Title: A Castle of Our Own
Summary: When an overworked architect takes an unexpected summer trip, a sandcastle contest and a contractor help her reconnect with her daughter, rediscover joy, and find love she never saw coming.

Title: Klepto
Summary: Nick (Jsu Garcia) mostly tolerates his job at Bernstein's department store, where he keeps an eye out for shoplifters using a set of cameras and monitors. One day, he spies Emily (Meredith Bishop) skillfully walking out with some goods, and, intrigued, Nick lets her get away. They cross paths again later, after he is fired from the store and has problems with a gang of moneylenders. Hatching a scheme to rob his former employer, Nick blackmails Emily into helping him execute it.

Title: My Grandfather Charles Manson
Summary: Sophia was always the good girl growing up and her father’s rock, but her quest to identify her unknown grandfather results in a shocking discovery: He is CHARLES MANSON, history’s most notorious criminal; and he bears striking physical similarities to her beloved father. Sophia’s discovery propels her into an underworld of Manson family members and unreliable narrators as she traces her grandfather’s life. Along the way, her genetics unlock never-before-released records and audio recordings that illuminate Manson’s pathology in startling ways. But the more Sophia uncovers, the more her relationship with her father is strained. For Sophia, there’s no turning back. What has she inherited, and how will she reckon with her family legacy?
Producer: Matt Renner, Alexandra Orton, Eric Cook

Title: The Huntress
Summary: After being widowed, Dottie Thorson can think of only one way to make ends meet: taking over her dead husband's bounty hunter business. Her daughter Brandi is thrilled with the idea, and soon the two are chasing criminals throughout Los Angeles. The reluctant mother and overly enthusiastic daughter gradually get better at their job, and when Brandi gets a lead on her father's killer they decide to track him down and exact revenge.

Title: The Depths
Summary: A famous fashion photographer on assignment in Japan becomes friends with a male escort.

Title: Exiles of Earth
Summary: Five stories follow humanity beyond Earth, where explorers and survivors face alien worlds, impossible choices and the struggle to find a new place to call home.
Director: Matteo Scarfò, Karl Redgen, Gio Ursino

Title: Andromeda
Summary: A young man must travel to the furthest reaches of the universe to find his long-lost father.

Title: Levitating
Summary: In a town where people find pleasure in being possessed by spiritual beings, 20-year-old Bayu aspires to become the shaman of a trance party to prevent impending eviction.
Producer: Amalia Fitriani, Siera Tamihardja, Iman Usman, Amalia Rusdi
Screenwriter: Alicia Angelina, Wregas Bhanuteja, Wregas Bhanuteja, Defi Mahendra, Alicia Angelina

Title: What I'd Do for Love
