Title: Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World
Summary: If poetry had a pop icon, Mary Oliver would be it. Celebrated best-selling poet, Pulitzer Prize-winner, lover of dogs and long walks in the woods, openly queer but intensely private, Oliver was America's unlikely contemporary mystic, stalking the ponds and forests of Cape Cod for nearly fifty years in order to open herself -- and her readers -- to the known and unknowable world. From a lonely childhood to literary fame, Oliver's life was shaped by devotion to nature, paying attention, and the long journey toward learning to love and to be loved. Her poems inspire liberals and conservatives, atheists and believers, naturalists and urbanites, speaking directly to contemporary anxieties about attention, presence, and the human relationship with the natural world -- issues that feel especially pressing in an era of climate crisis, digital distraction, and social fragmentation. Featuring interviews with her close friends, including John Waters, never-before-seen personal photos, notebooks, and correspondence from her archive, and recitations of her work by Stephen Colbert, Lucy Dacus, Steve Buscemi, and Oprah Winfrey, Mary Oliver: Saved by the Beauty of the World considers the poet's long lifetime of work in context, capturing the uniqueness of her world and the natural beauty that inspired her.

Title: Lust
Summary: A famous crime writer begins to experience strange events after she is brutally attacked by a crazed fan.
Producer: Severin Eskeland, Reinert Horneland, Jimmi Salomonsen

Title: The Salisbury Poisonings: A Spy Next Door
Summary: Through firsthand testimony from senior intelligence leaders, journalists and victims, this film details the events of the 2018 Novichok nerve agent attack that transformed a quiet English city into the epicenter of a geopolitical crisis.

Title: The Next Karate Kid
Summary: Karate master Mr. Miyagi goes to Boston to attend a military reunion. There, he visits with Louisa, the widow of his former commander, and meets her granddaughter, Julie. Julie's parents were recently killed in a car accident, and she is still reeling from the loss. As Chad confronts personal loss and life-altering choices, the film presents an energetic, humorous, and deeply personal portrait of a man who, despite being told he wouldn't survive childhood, refuses to shrink his life, or his ambition.

Over the airwaves, he stumbles upon a strange woman, Eva, who suffers from paranoia and agoraphobia, and hides a dark secret of her own. Wary at first, she slowly begins to thaw, and they strike up a distant friendship -- their respective radios the only thread that connects them. But Eva isn’t the only thing that comes to him through the radio. Something desperate has stirred, attempting to reach William, to take hold of him and pull him into the shadow world of memories best left forgotten. The two worlds collide, and William is rushed down a path that is paved with deceit, lies and an awful truth, a truth that pulls him into a world of darkness from which he cannot escape.

Title: Yo (Love is a Rebellious Bird)

It's just big enough for Anna to squeeze through the door, and Inside lives a puppet of her friend Yo. When the pair first met, Yo was 73 and Anna 24. It was a love at first sight friendship that defied age, time and death. Over the decades, they form a deep bond. After Yo's death, Anna re-constructs a magical space where Yo's stories unfold, and their relationship continues. The film juxtaposes intimate vérité of Yo's last year with Anna's creative interpretations of Yo's dramatic life stories. Born in Switzerland in 1924, Yo lived life on her own terms, defying expectations around sexuality, mothering, aging, and even death. As the film blurs memory, time and invention, it also reveals the power of artistic creation to channel--and share--grief and love.

Title: Kim Novak's Vertigo
Summary: At 92, Kim Novak remains one of Hollywood's most enduring enigmas -- a luminous star who, at the peak of her fame, turned her back on the spotlight to embrace a life of self-expression and authenticity. Once the top box office draw in the world, she rebelled against the studio system and the confines of celebrity, choosing individuality over image, and art over artifice. KIM NOVAK'S VERTIGO is a lyrical and intimate portrait, blending rare archival footage with deeply personal reflections and vivid glimpses into Kim's reclusive life. While Alfred Hitchcock's Vertigo remains her most iconic role, the film explores how that performance -- and the duality it captured -- mirrors the ongoing tension between image and identity that shaped Kim's life. As she revisits fragments of her past a deeper story emerges: one of defiance, reinvention, and the quiet power of a woman who walked away from fame to remain true to herself.

Despite their differences in approach to caring for him, both have the same goal of keeping him safe and connected. Miguel's caretaking is straightforward--he focuses on Mr. Pearson's basic needs: eating, sleeping, and grooming. Caroline, however, has become more than a nurse. A maternal confidante and playful companion, Caroline stops at nothing to keep Mr. Pearson from slipping away, even if that means casting herself opposite the leading man to perform a scene from one of his old films. And it's working. Caroline and Robert's make-believe games cause him to feel alive again, but as the line between fantasy and reality blurs, his grip loosens as Caroline's gets tighter. Now, with everyone's livelihood on the line, Miguel and Caroline must work together to save Mr. Pearson's luminous star from fading to black.

When comedian Mike Ward made a joke about Jeremy Gabriel--a young singer with a disability--it ignited a decade-long legal battle that climbed all the way to the Supreme Court. Provocative, unflinching, and darkly humorous, American Troll explores the cost of standing your ground. In the face of relentless adversity, it reveals how conviction can lead not only to personal growth, but also to public backlash, online cruelty, personal struggles, and very expensive lawyer bills.

Brian Espinosa is a young, troubled man who has had more than his share of police contact. When his longtime girlfriend, Melody, overdoses, Brian enlists the help of his best friend, Sarah. When Sarah arrives, Melody has miraculously returned, yet she is not quite herself. Detectives Madsen and Slater are en route to apprehend Brian on a criminal warrant. They are not prepared for what transpires at Brian's home, for they encounter beings and happenings that indicate the very beginning of what the spiritual would call the rapture. Both men are pulled into a world of mind-bending realities, and are soon not only fighting for their lives, but are entangled in a war for the entire human race.

At its center are John and LaMonté, whose bond is tested as pressure mounts -- LaMonté's mental health deteriorates while John struggles to remain sober. As the husband and wife offer conflicting accounts of what happened, the night replays in shifting, Rashomon-like fragments - a slow-motion squeeze of a trigger that exposes a troubling story of identity, community, love, and betrayal.

Title: The Vampire Lestat: One Night Only LIVE
Echo
Summary: In Iceland, as everyone prepares for the Christmas holidays, a special atmosphere takes over the country. Between exaltation and anxiety, a biting and tender portrait of a modern society.
Producer: Rúnar Rúnarsson, Live Hide, Lilja Ósk Snorradóttir

Title: The Library
Summary: Two college music students are pushed to the brink of insanity while working in the library.

Title: Jackpot
Summary: Jackpot, Nevada is a town one hundred miles south of Twin Falls, Idaho. But Jackpot also means the payout of a slot machine-wealth without effort. For Sunny Holiday (Jon Gries), the pathway to success is to become a country-western singer. Abandoning his beautiful wife Bobbi (Daryl Hannah) and their young baby, he sets off with his manager Lester Les Irving (Garrett Morris) on a nine-month, forty-three-city tour through a series of bleak western towns.
Production Co: Jackpot Film Productions, Polish Brothers Construction

Title: Florida Man
Summary: Animated tales of true-life news stories from Florida.

Title: Cockroach
Summary: In February 2019, the Hong Kong government proposed a bill, which would have allowed extradition of criminal suspects from Hong Kong to face trial in mainland China. The controversial bill sparked immediate outrage over widespread fear of arbitrary detention and politically motivated trials that would decimate Hong Kong's autonomy under 'one country, two systems.' Anti-bill protests escalated into pro-democracy demonstrations. "Cockroach," filmed during the height of the protests, captures the extraordinary intensity of an unprecedented era in Hong Kong's history. Spanning the evolution of the protest movement, it captures street demonstrations, police suppression and violence, and key events, such as the multi-day siege of Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Interviews with Hong Kongers feature activists, protestors, politicians, ordinary citizens, and policemen. Prominent legislators, lawyers and activists articulate the perils of intensifying assaults on freedoms and rule of law.

Title: The Lovers
Summary: In the course of one evening, a bored French housewife meets and falls in love with a young archaeologist.

Title: Communion
Summary: A novelist's (Christopher Walken) wife (Lindsay Crouse) and son (Joel Carlson) see him changed by an apparent encounter with aliens in the mountains.
Producer: Dan Allingham, Philippe Mora, Whitley Strieber
Production Co: Allied Vision, The Picture Property Company, Pheasantry Films

Title: Marrow
Summary: A woman struggles to restore her dilapidated home and rebuild her relationship with her son.
Screenwriter: Brent Curtis, Eliza Fox, Frances Hearn, Matt Wilkins, Ryan Purcell

Title: Public Access
Summary: When charismatic vagrant Whiley Pritcher arrives at a small, sleepy town, he promptly starts a disturbing public access television program. The show, "Our Town," becomes an explosively popular hit and a piercing investigative platform for locals to air their grievances about life in their deceptively idyllic community. Yet, as scandals surface and tensions progressively rise, the citizenry begins to wonder if Whiley is driven by some unsettling hidden agenda.

Title: Reus
Summary: A chronicle of two crime families' struggle to control the Reus neighborhood of Montevideo, Uruguay.

Title: Emil and the Detectives
Summary: A 12-year-old (Bryan Russell) employs a group of street-wise youngsters to help him track down a thief.

Title: Laruan
Summary: Thea, a married woman, rendezvouses with her lover, Geoff, at her house during dinner. But when a new woman enters the picture, Thea's wild and crazy gameplay changes.

Title: Pretty Babies
Producer: Jordan Wagner, Christine Vachon, Ashley Benson

Title: Lateral Thinking
Screenwriter: Mariano Hueter, Ezequiel Goldstein, José Militano

Title: Shine
Summary: As a child piano prodigy, David Helfgott's musical ambitions generate friction with his overbearing father, Peter. When Helfgott travels to London on a musical scholarship, his career as a pianist blossoms. However, the pressures of his newfound fame, coupled with the echoes of his tumultuous childhood, conspire to bring Helfgott's latent schizophrenia boiling to the surface, and he spends years in and out of various mental institutions.

Title: Harvest
Summary: A man (Azaniah) dreams of leaving a Caribbean island and sailing to Martinique.
Four women must face their problems in a world that is stranger than it seems.

Title: Corpus
Summary: It's the summer of 1998 in New York City; Sayo (Jeff Wahlberg, EUPHORIA), a soulful nightlife photographer and small-time drug dealer, is invited to a party upstate by his long-time friend and unrequited love, a movie star on the rise: Vince Marlowe (Brodie Townsend, HEARTBREAK HIGH). Together with their rowdy friend Ross (Michael Vlamis, POOLS), they drive to a remote, bucolic manor in hopes of some summer debauchery. But when they arrive, they discover that the promise of a party is actually three mysterious women -- Billie (Lily Cowles, ANTEBELLUM), Wren (Nuha Jes Izman, YELLOWJACKETS) and Cata (Ching Valdes-Aran, THE EQUALIZER) -- whose disturbing agenda draws the boys into a dark web of seduction and terror.
Producer: Corrin Evans, Lily Cowles, Sarah Mather, Thomas Wallis, Alix Taylor

Title: Haunted
Summary: Supernatural events convince an Englishwoman that she is the reincarnation of a long-dead Indian priestess.

Title: Carl Sagan: We Are Made of Star Stuff
Producer: Nanette Burstein, Ann Druyan, Erica Huggins, Seth MacFarlane, Timothy Moran

Title: Newlyweds
Summary: A newlywed couple's honeymoon turns upside down when their sisters show up unexpectedly.
Producer: Edward Burns, Aaron Lubin, William Rexer

Title: Uyir
Summary: Sundar lives with his brother's family but is unaware that his sister-in-law, Arundathi, lusts for him. After his brother's suicide, Sundar is forced to look after Arundathi and her children.

Title: Dog Day
Summary: An American bank robber on the run in France is held hostage by a family of depraved farmers.
Screenwriter: Jean Herman, Michel Audiard, Dominique Roulet, Serge Korber, Yves Boisset

Title: On Call
Summary: Migrants file in and out of a refugee medical center in the suburbs of Paris. Within a single room, a general practitioner, aided by a psychiatrist, tries to repair their bodies and minds.

Title: The Visitation
Summary: Supernatural events coincide with the arrival of a mysterious stranger (Edward Furlong) in a small town.
Production Co: Namesake Entertainment, Signal Hill Pictures LLC

Title: Judaa
Summary: A once bright young man, now broken by grief, survives on memories of the woman he loved. To his village he is only a drunkard. To Gaggi, he was everything, and even in ruin he refuses to let her dream die.
Producer: Hardeep Meen, Bharti Prashar, Narinder Singh Rathour

Title: False Pretense
Summary: An officer (Eric Roberts) discovers a police cover-up while investigating his ex-wife's suspicious death.
Production Co: A-Pix Entertainment, Canadian Film or Video Production Tax Credit (CPTC)

Title: Didn't Die
Summary: A podcast host, Vinita (Kiran Deol), struggles to maintain her dwindling audience amid the zombie apocalypse, but when her ex shows up with an orphaned baby, priorities shift in order to battle the ever-mutating zombie threat.
Producer: Erica Fishman, Joe Camerota, Luke Patton, Meera Menon, Paul Gleason

Title: Sugar
Summary: Like many young men in the Dominican Republic, 19-year-old Miguel "Sugar" Santos (Algenis Perez Soto) dreams of winning a slot on an American baseball team. Indeed, his talents as a pitcher eventually land him a slot on a single-A team in Iowa, but culture shock, racism and other curveballs threaten to turn Sugar's dream sour.
Producer: Paul Mezey, Jamie Patricof, Jeremy Kipp Walker

Title: Stand Up
Summary: A young man has his legs and hand taken in an industrial accident and has to fight the company he worked for with his new girlfriend to be treated fairly.

Title: Back in Black
Summary: Clyde Mortimer is a broke stressed-out funeral director on the edge of ruin in an economically depressed small town. It's the end of the pandemic and there were no funerals or visitations allowed for the longest time. And now, nobody has died in town for months. His introverted anarchistic granddaughter, Sam, can't stand her grandparents fighting over finances and she decides to help out the family business by collaborating with fate in a most unusual way. The local police are no match for Sam's criminal sneakiness, and she finds true love on her journey while an unlucky few pay the ultimate price for the Mortimer's return to success. A darkly funny, increasingly unhinged story about family, money, and just how far people will go for the ones they love.
Producer: Elizabeth Levine, William Woods, Maddy Falle, Ron Murphy

Title: Sunset Strip Killers
Summary: Beneath the neon glow of the Sunset Strip, Carol, a lonely nurse, becomes entangled with Doug, a charismatic yet deeply unstable man with violent impulses.
Producer: Michael Conroy, Chad Ferrin, Jerry Irons, Silvia Spross
Production Co: Crappy World Films, Dance On Productions, Laurelwood Pictures

Title: Magic
Summary: Corky (Anthony Hopkins), a failed magician, adopts a new ventriloquist act with an abrasive dummy named Fats, and suddenly finds himself lined up for a television show. When the unbalanced Corky fears he won't pass the required mental exam, he runs away with Fats to his hometown, where he meets an old love from high school, Peggy (Ann-Margret). Corky persuades Peggy to leave her loveless marriage -- but Fats, who seems to be taking on a mind of his own, doesn't approve of the relationship.
Producer: Joseph E. Levine, Richard P. Levine

Title: Mavka: The True Myth
Summary: The story unfolds in the ancient Ukrainian forest during the mystical Mermaid Week -- the once in 4 years time when mythical creatures are believed to emerge from the Dark Lake to hunt for filthy human souls to feed on their energy. Mavka is one of the forest lake's nymphs. When she meets Lukian, a biology whizz, she has one job: to bring him to her lake, where mermaids and other nymphs lie in wait. But instead of bringing about Lukian's ruin, Mavka falls in love with him. As her feelings grow stronger, she starts to realize that the mermaids will go to any length to keep her on the dark side.

Title: Blood Money
Summary: Escaped prisoners force a man who testified against one of them to aid getaway plans.

Title: Unintended Consequences
Summary: A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother's honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress.

Title: Closer
Summary: Alice (Natalie Portman), an American stripper who has moved to London, meets Dan (Jude Law) on the street. While looking at him, a taxi hits her. After taking her to the hospital, Dan begins dating Alice. A year later, Dan -- who has written a novel about Alice -- is bored. He flirts with photographer Anna (Julia Roberts). Pretending to be her in a chat room, he leads dermatologist Larry (Clive Owen) to an accidental meeting with Anna. As the years pass, both relationships disintegrate.
Producer: Robert Fox, Scott Rudin, John Calley, Cary Brokaw

Title: The River Train
Summary: 9-year-old Milo lives in a remote village in Argentina, where he trains as a malambo dancer. But his true dreams lie elsewhere: he longs to ride trains and explore Buenos Aires, the city he has only seen in movies. To break free from his small world, he must dare to embark on a new journey: loneliness.
Producer: Tomas Grandio, Valentine Torre, Casiana Vera

Title: Dreamscape
Summary: Selfish teen Alex Gardner (Dennis Quaid) is coerced into joining a government project in which psychics like him are trained to enter others' dreams. He starts learning to use his abilities to do good, but before long, a new official, Bob Blair (Christopher Plummer), seizes control of the project. A writer (George Wendt) helps Alex uncover Blair's true motives, which involve assassination via dreams. Soon, only Alex and a beautiful scientist (Kate Capshaw) stand in the way of something terrible.

Title: Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness
Summary: Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness is a one-of-a-kind documentary that explores all the major psychedelics, not just by explaining how they work medicinally, but by showing it. The film takes viewers inside dosing rooms for extremely rare looks at the remarkable power, emotion, and speed of psychedelic healing in action: from pro athletes repairing brain damage from concussions, to combat veterans finding relief from suicidal despair, to a woman breaking free from opioid addiction, to survivors of the Nova Music Festival massacre who say being on psychedelics during the attack shielded them from developing mental trauma. Peaking also traces the turbulent history of how psychedelics were criminalized in the 1960s and how, ever since, they've been moving from the underground to the mainstream in a rise that might soon lead to their legalization in the United States and beyond.

Title: Kill and Go Hide
Summary: A 1930s widower (Frank Janson) hires a governess (Laurel Barnett) for his daughter (Rosalie Cole) who can summon zombies.

Title: Velvet
Summary: In 1965, Eve and Austin commit a heist and hide out in the desert together.

Title: Front Row
Summary: Front Row follows how the United Ukrainian Ballet Company welcomed Oleksandr Budko, a wounded soldier who lost both his legs in the war, into their midst. Budko becomes a reminder of every brother, father, and friend the dancers had to leave behind. With their collaboration through ballet, they are all able to transform their grief into something beautiful and bigger than themselves.

Title: Daylight
Summary: A group of armed robbers fleeing the police head for the New Jersey Tunnel and run right into trucks transporting toxic waste. The spectacular explosion that follows results in both ends of the tunnel collapsing and the handful of people who survived the explosion are now in peril. Kit Latura is the only man with the skill and knowledge to lead the band of survivors out of the tunnel before the structure collapses.
Producer: John Davis, Joseph Singer, David T. Friendly
Production Co: Universal Pictures, Joseph M. Singer Entertainment, Davis Entertainment

Title: Someone's Daughter
Summary: A criminal defense lawyer, Sam, (Pascale Bussières, Ma Vie en cinémascope, When Night is Falling), finds herself kidnapped and abandoned on a remote island along with former client Paul (François Arnaud, Heated Rivalry, Fucktoys, The Borgias), who she previously cleared of sexual assault charges. As they make their way through the unrelenting Canadian wilderness, Paul's behavior forces Sam to question the man she once defended. As doubt gives way to fear, she finds herself facing a choice no lawyer should ever have to make.

Title: Irish Goodbye
Summary: Strangers from opposite ends of the earth meet in the City of Angels and embark on a journey of trust, abandonment, tragedy and privilege.
Producer: Kwabena Darkwah, Jared Safier, Danny Page

Title: Lo
Summary: A man uses a demon to save his girlfriend, but the demon has a nefarious plan.

Title: Obsession
Summary: A young man becomes dangerously obsessed with a woman.

Title: Not Alone
Summary: After the loss of his father, a young man spirals into addiction.

Title: Sara
Summary: The daughter of a wealthy gangster falls in love with her bodyguard, who then becomes the target of her father and her father's enemies.

Title: Anthony
Summary: Set along the coastal shores of Jaffna, the story follows a fisherman and his family whose lives are inseparably tied to the sea. As he struggles to balance his responsibilities toward his profession and his family, a tender love story unfolds, shaping his choices and testing his values. Daily life within the fishing community, its hardships, traditions, and unspoken bonds, forms the backdrop of the narrative. When personal desires begin to clash with family expectations, the protagonist is forced to confront sacrifice, loyalty, and the true meaning of love. Through moments of romance, conflict, and emotional depth, the film reveals the strength of family ties and the resilience of a community that survives by trusting the sea and each other.

Title: Rage
Summary: In this made-for-TV movie, Cal Morrisey (David Soul) is a husband and father convicted of rape who is serving time in an institution and attempting to confront the reasons he ended up there. Using techniques of group therapy with fellow inmates, Morrisey is prompted by his therapist, Borski (James Whitmore), to delve into his difficult past for answers. What he discovers is a lifetime of pain that has scarred him deeply, but nevertheless may lead him on the path to recovery.

Title: Soul Catcher
Summary: Stories show the abandoned buildings of the notorious boarding schools built to house Native American children.
Director: Christopher Saint Booth, Philip Adrian Booth
Screenwriter: Christopher Saint Booth, Philip Adrian Booth

Title: Pretty Ugly: The Story of the Lunachicks
Summary: Punk music icons, Lunachicks, reunite after 20 years in an unfiltered, hilarious, and electric documentary. Packed with rare archival footage, the film traces their rise from gritty NYC teens to feminist trailblazers of the 90s grunge era. Fans and newcomers alike will thrill as the band recounts old antics, rekindles bonds, and embarks on their long-awaited journey back to the stage.

Title: Dream Girl
Summary: A modern female Robin Hood becomes the dream girl of a wealthy bachelor.
Producer: Gulshan Rai, Jaya Chakraborty, J.K. Behl

Title: Paraíso Perdido
Summary: A cop moonlights as the bodyguard for a young drag queen at a nightclub and grows closer to the family of misfit singers that perform there.

Title: Puppy
Summary: After a madman kidnaps a con artist, she has to muster her skills to escape.

Title: Safe Exit
Summary: A psychological thriller following Samaan, a young security guard who belongs to a generation whose parents were murdered by religious and ethnic violence in the Arab region over the past decade. Once children, they are now young adults in their early twenties, still struggling with inherited trauma.

Title: Monday
Summary: Salaryman Koichi (Shinichi Tsutsumi) awakens one Monday morning with a terrible hangover and no memory of how he got where he is. He struggles to piece together the events of the previous weekend, first discovering evidence that he was at a funeral, which ended very badly. He remembers that things started to get really strange after he met Shingo (Hideki Noda), a barroom fortune-teller, and they became downright dangerous after he befriended Yuko (Yasuko Matsuyuki), a gangster's beautiful moll.

Title: Misophonia
Summary: When Martin is fired and subsequently forced to move in with his sister following a Misophonia outburst at work, he sets out on a comically disgruntled mission to identify ways he might manage his Misophonia and get his life back on track.

Title: A Bit of Light
Summary: A Bit of Light unfolds as an intimate story about a recovering alcoholic named Ella (Anna Paquin). A series of tough breaks forces Ella to move back in with her father Alan (Ray Winstone), while her daughters are under the care of her ex-husband Joseph (Youssef Kerkour) and his new partner Bethan (Pippa Bennett-Warner). Mired in guilt, the protagonist finds herself in fights with Joseph and Bethan about the kids and Alan over AA meetings. However, an unlikely friendship with Neil (Luca Hogan) opens her eyes to taking responsibility and making the changes she needs to make.
Producer: Phin Glynn, Axel Kuschevatzky, Anna Paquin, Isabelle Georgeaux, Stephen Moyer
Production Co: Great Point Media, ICM Partners, Infinity Hill

Title: Another Time
Summary: The top investment manager at his firm is assigned to help the stunning owner of a recently acquired company. He realizes he has fallen for her, and he has to go back in time to meet her before she becomes engaged.
Production Co: Gravitas Ventures, Angry Jimmy Films, AfterBurner Entertainment

Title: Gregor
Summary: When Gregor is fired from his job, he searches for a fit girlfriend and a well-paying job.
Producer: Daisy Mostyn, Tom Lazenby, Alice Pearse

Title: The Mission
Summary: A young Iranian agent (Houshang Touzie) travels to New York City following the Islamic revolution that seized his country, on a mission to kill a colonel who was in league with the shah. The agent accidentally meets the colonel (Parviz Sayyad), and the two become friends. The agent then has second thoughts about his mission and questions the motives of the new Islamic state back home. His superiors wonder whether he will go through with the mission and pay him a visit.

Title: Malevolent
Summary: Framed for several murders, a police officer (Lou Diamond Phillips) launches a personal investigation to uncover the killer's identity.

Title: Adam's Apple
Summary: A transgender teen and his mother chronicle their lives, artistically weaving a rare and intimate portrait of a family in transition. Two decades of footage trace a boy's path to manhood and his parents' vulnerability as they reckon with change. ADAM'S APPLE is an intimate, collaborative documentary told through the dual perspectives of Adam, a transgender teen, and his mother, visual artist Amy Jenkins, offering an authentic and tender counterpoint to the hostility facing trans youth today. Adam's journey balances the milestones of gender transition with the rhythms of adolescence. As Adam asserts his identity and steps out into the world, his parents grapple with the challenges of raising a teen while learning to let go. Through a visually poetic approach, the film transforms a deeply personal archive, collected over two decades, into a powerful, joyful testament to the beauty and difficulty of reckoning with profound change.

Title: Just Friends
Summary: High school student Chris Brander (Ryan Reynolds) loves his best friend, Jamie Palamino (Amy Smart). He finally confesses his feelings, but she tells him that she just wants to be friends, and he leaves town in shame. Ten years later, Chris is a successful record executive and involved with self-absorbed pop star Samantha James (Anna Faris). He still pines for Jamie, though, and when his plans to go to Paris for the holidays fall through, he returns to his hometown to try and win her heart.
Producer: Chris Bender, Bill Johnson, Michael Ohoven, J.C. Spink, William Vince
Production Co: Just Friends Productions Inc., Cinerenta, Inferno Distribution, Benderspink

Title: EE
Summary: A doctor wants to test lethal injections on unsuspecting slum dwellers, so Easwaran or E, who lives in the same slum and is a minor criminal, brings him to justice.

Title: Josh Johnson: Symphony
Summary: Josh Johnson performs all new material about our shared experiences as humans. While many audiences know Johnson from his prolific YouTube presence and takes on timely issues as a rotating host of “The Daily Show,” his hourlong special highlights the comedian’s unique point of view and signature creativity as he reflects on strange childhood experiences, the perils of being labeled “nice,” challenging family dynamics, and navigating life’s most awkward moments.

Title: Doll
Summary: Implants allow a man to experience any fantasy he wants.

Title: The Hunt
Summary: After being accused of killing his friend, a man finds that he is being pursued by the real murderer.

Title: A Murder Between Friends
Summary: When six friends vacation at the country estate of a true-crime TV star, the last thing they expect to find is someone murdered in a hot tub! Everyone is a suspect as they try to determine who among them would have the means, motive and opportunity.
Producer: Joan Collins, Trent Garrett, Percy Gibson, Jacob Young

Title: House IV
Summary: The widow (Terri Treas) and daughter of a car-crash victim (William Katt) move into an old house haunted by an Indian curse.
Production Co: New Line Cinema, Sean S. Cunningham Films

Title: Drift
Summary: A man returns to the London neighborhood where he grew up.

Title: Loafers
Summary: Amid a post-grad haze, best friends Isaac and Cameron navigate the shifting terrain of their relationships, grappling with the deeper question of whether their once unbreakable friendship can survive the weight of change.

Title: Under My Skin
Summary: Free-spirited artist Denny falls for straight-laced lawyer Ryan, but their love gets tested when Denny begins to question gender.

Title: Contact
Summary: Small actions lead to major consequences.

Title: Nekai Walks
Summary: In the summer of 2023, a Toronto teenager leaves home with his first paycheck, planning nothing more dangerous than a game of basketball. As dawn turns to darkness, he is caught in a hail of gunfire on a North York street.

Title: The Peril at Pincer Point
Summary: Jim Baitte, a layabout sound designer desperate to prove himself, is working on a new horror flick from the tyrannical yet lauded b-movie director P.W. Griffin. Accused of lacking vision and creative courage, Jim is sent to the remote island where the film was shot to capture a sound powerful enough to elevate the film's finale. Once there, eerie local fables surface: for years, ambitious and headstrong youth have lost their souls to a ghostly sea captain for his spectral crew. As Jim entangles himself further into the bizarre locals, scenery, and prophecy, he can't help but ponder the ever-confirming legend, and if recording it might just cost him more than his career.

Title: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'
Summary: Caught between old-school roots and new-school norms, Bruce Bruce riffs on family, fame and the real definition of foreplay in his debut Netflix special.

Title: Goodbye Monster
Summary: While trying to save the Healing Island from dark spirits, a healer with an untested theory and amazing powers accidentally destroys it. Banished for years, he returns to help a lovable young patient and hopes to redeem himself by restoring his home and healing the world.
Screenwriter: Xiaoyu Wu, Jianming Huang, Liang Li

Title: Into the Blue
Summary: Divers Sam and Jared love life in the Bahamas. But when friends Bryce and Amanda visit, the couple take them on a treasure-hunting trip, where they discover more than they bargained for, a downed airplane full of cocaine alongside a famous shipwreck. Unknown to Sam and Jared, Bryce makes a fatal mistake and decides to sell the cocaine, which angers a group of drug dealers, who are in hot pursuit of the divers.
Rating: PG-13 (Intense Sequence of Violence|Drug Material|Language|Some Sexual Content)

Title: Perfect
Summary: A Rolling Stone reporter (John Travolta) seduces an aerobics instructor (Jamie Lee Curtis) while doing a story on health clubs for singles.

Title: Do Us Part
Summary: Ryan's wedding day becomes chaotic when Rose, his college best friend and unrequited love, crashes the ceremony to come clean about her buried feelings. Rose's arrival forces Ryan to confront the emotional baggage of their past, but it's not just old feelings that threaten to unravel the day. Mark, Ryan's best man, must navigate a minefield of secrets, including his own, to save the wedding.
Producer: Reed Arnold, Nic Vannatta, Xander Black
Production Co: Hello Starling Films, Warm Soda Films, Stargazer Media

Title: Spiral
Summary: A winning streak at an illegal gambling club comes to an end for a young tech whiz when he finds himself on the run from his criminal cronies.

Title: Famous Last Words: Eric Dane
Summary: In this emotional interview, the late actor and ALS advocate Eric Dane shared his final message for the world — knowing it would not air until his death.

Title: My Dead Summer
Summary: Kenny Rodgers Royce lives to tell stories and his blog is his outlet to connect with the world. His newest must-tell story came to him in a dream: to follow in his late mother's Deadhead footsteps as he captures the final tour of Dead and Company. Accompanied by a two-man film crew, his dog Lily Pad, and his ex-hippy stepfather, every adventure and misadventure is captured in stunning detail.
Producer: Bill Brennenstuhl, Paul Stenerson, Dalen Muster, Kevin Muster

Title: The Twin Who Lived
Summary: After learning she had a twin who died, Claire starts receiving strange gifts signed with her sister's name. What seems like a prank soon escalates into disturbing signs that someone is breaking into her home and trying to take control of her life.

Title: Wanderlust
Summary: An elderly Italian man sets out to find a wife.

Title: Susie
Summary: Susie and Andy's relationship has become toxic. In order to deal with Andy's controlling and emotionally damaging actions, Susie begins to manifest a real and physical horror.

Title: In Sickness and in Health
Summary: Three same-sex couples fight the state of New Jersey for the right to marry, including a lesbian couple whose dream was cut short when one partner was diagnosed with Lou Gehrig's disease.

Title: My Husband's Sister
Summary: A reformed con artist must confront the murderous caregiver he left behind when she targets the wealthy woman who has given him a chance at redemption.

Title: All Alone
Summary: Maggie goes on a camping trip with two of her friends, and they encounter a radical environmentalist who leads them down a path to violence and desperation.
Producer: Jon Cellini, Suzy Cote, Messiah Jacobs, Mandy Levin, Beth Navarro, Brice Williams, Jim Fabio

Title: Easy Girl
Summary: Spending every evening in a new and mysterious stranger's bed, capricious transient Nore agrees to move into a spare room eagerly offered to her by Jonna, a reserved medical student. Against the odds, this unlikely pair finds solace in each other and fall into an intoxicating pattern of partying hard at night with the local men vying for their attention. As their relationship intensifies, Nore's troubled past comes to light and threatens to dismantle the blissfully ignorant, inexplicably jubilant lifestyle they've built together in this "candy-colored, flamboyant and deeply personal film." (Variety)
Producer: Anette Unger, Sven Rudat, Paula Lichte

Title: Rave
Summary: Several teenagers (Douglas Spain, Aimee Graham, Nicholle Tom) enter a dangerous world when they go to a party in downtown Los Angeles.
Producer: Michael Kolko, Ron Krauss, Ilan Lewinger
Screenwriter: Kristene A. Tata, Ron Krauss, Mario Zavala

Title: Sahaa - Life of Sanju
Summary: A dreamer, a love story, and a life that refuses to go as planned -- SAHAA blends humor, heart, and hard-hitting drama into the story of Sanju: an ordinary man fighting to keep the life and love he always dreamed of.

Title: Cotton Candy
Summary: A woman reflects on her life while watching a circus act with her granddaughter.

Title: Jurassic Rampage
Summary: A family fights for survival when dinosaurs escape from an armored truck and invade a nearby neighborhood.

Title: O
Summary: Moving the classic tale of Othello onto the basketball courts of a high school, the story focuses on a young black man named Odin (Mekhi Phifer) who is convinced by a conniving best friend, Hugo (Josh Hartnett) that his girlfriend (Julia Stiles) is cheating on him. Of course, what Odin doesn't know is that Hugo is in fact motivated by his own jealousy of Odin's good fortune. It's a sticky situation in classic Shakespearean tradition.
Producer: Daniel Fried, Eric Gitter, Anthony Rhulen
Production Co: Chickie the Cop, Daniel Fried Entertainment, Rhulen Entertainment

Title: Medusa
Summary: Mari and her friends broadcast their spiritual devotion through pastel pinks and catchy evangelical songs about purity and perfection, but underneath it all they harbor a deep rage. By day they hide behind their manicured façade, and by night they form a masked, vigilante girl gang, prowling the streets in search of sinners who have deviated from the rightful path. After an attack goes wrong, leaving Mari scarred and unemployed, her view of community, religion, and her peers begin to shift. Nightmares of repressed desires and haunting visions of alluring temptation become undeniable and the urge to scream and release her paralyzing inner demons is more powerful than ever before. A neon-tinged genre-bender that gives provocative form to the overwhelming feminine fury coursing through modern life, MEDUSA dares us not to look away.
Production Co: MyMama Entertainment, Canal Brasil, Bananeira Filmes, Peccadillo Pictures, Telecine, Vitrine Filmes

Title: Your Attention Please
Summary: A new generation of parents, teens, and reformers are fighting back against Big Tech's agenda to define the future of human connection. From Kristin, a mother pursuing legislative reform after losing her son, to Trisha, a young programmer building technology to stop cyberbullying, the film reveals how deeply the attention economy is shaping childhood, mental health, and human connection. As lawmakers debate the Kids Online Safety Act, Gen Z launches a global "Offline Club" movement, and a high school dares to go phone-free. What emerges is not a doomsday story, but a hopeful one: proof that the attention crisis is not inevitable and that a cultural shift is already underway.

Her loving, but overbearing parents help her through recovery (despite her cringing) and learn that saying "vagina" loud and proud is the first step to advocating for herself in all aspects of her life. On the verge of finally breaking into her dream career in Los Angeles, Paige (in a hilariously deadpan performance by Valentina Tammaro) is forced to put everything on hold, move back in with her parents, and undergo a vulvar vestibulectomy, in order to alleviate years of vaginal pain. Paige's excruciating and hilarious road to recovery makes the health and wellbeing of her lady parts a family affair, as her loving but over-enthusiastic parents learn that saying "vagina" loud and proud is the first step to advocating for women's health. Based on writer/executive producer Bonnie Gross's true story, Gross and director Nancy Boyd both pull from their own, horrifically cringe-worthy experiences with vaginal pain and the difficulties women face receiving treatment. Lady Parts is heartfelt, laugh-out-loud funny, and brutally honest, offering audiences a glimpse into an experience many women face, but few talk about, either on or offscreen.

Title: The Welcome Table
Summary: We are on the verge of one of the largest mass migrations in human history, and for many, it has already begun. One out of every three people will lose their homes due to climate change, making climate displacement one of the defining crises of our time. THE WELCOME TABLE tells the story of climate migrants across six continents, centering the voices and experiences of survivors on the front lines of the climate crisis while asking hard questions such as "where will we be safe?," "where will my family be safe?," and "how do we welcome those in harm's way?" With the powerful music of John Boutté and other legendary New Orleans artists, Fox brings together people from around the world who have lost their homes, safety, or stability to a changing planet, and asks audiences to imagine a more generous response to a crisis that continues to reshape lives. From the United States to the Caribbean, Italy, Kenya, Peru, Brazil, and Australia, the film traces the devastating human consequences of a changing climate -- from hurricanes and floods to droughts, rising seas, and the impact of extractive industries on Indigenous communities. Through intimate first-hand accounts, THE WELCOME TABLE captures the resilience and perseverance of communities amid life-altering upheaval and a world which increasingly chooses to build walls of exclusion in response. The film culminates in a massive singing celebration on the New Orleans levee, where a 1,000-foot table serves as a powerful expression of connection and resistance.

Production Co: HBO Documentary Films, International WOW Company

Traveling on the back roads to avoid the police, she stops for the night at the ramshackle Bates Motel and meets the polite but highly strung proprietor Norman Bates (Anthony Perkins), a young man with an interest in taxidermy and a difficult relationship with his mother.

Title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall

Title: AlieNation

Title: Mephisto

Great roles and plenty of praise accumulate quickly, and Hendrik revels in his success. He dreams of ultimately playing Mephisto, and to that end blithely overlooks the profound moral compromises of his situation.

Title: Meat
Summary: A pimp (Peter Wight) seeks vengeance when a prostitute (Sarah-Jane Potts) falls in love with a former convict (Jonny Lee Miller) and becomes pregnant.

Title: Solis

Producer: Charlette Kilby, Alan Latham, Carl Strathie, Caleb Wilson

Title: My Brother's Killer
Summary: The true crime story of Billy London, a gay adult film performer brutally killed in West Hollywood, that became an urban legend for 33 years. A documentary intended to honor his life took an unexpected turn when members of the community joined forces to uncover overlooked clues, seeking a resolution to the mystery of who killed him. The story of a life cut far too short, and the painful memories left behind.

When his ex-wife sues for custody of his beloved daughter, Emmylou, Todd hits rock bottom. Title: School for Defectors
Summary: In an industrial area of Busan, South Korea sits the tiny Jangdaehyun School. It has just 20 students, all of whom are North Korean defectors. "School For Defectors" tells a joyful story of youth, inspiration, and our shared humanity.

Title: The Box
Summary: An obsessive actor begins to question his sanity after he finds himself repeatedly trapped in a nightmare that is eerily similar to a film he is auditioning for.

Title: No Paradise If You Are Killed by a Woman
Summary: Vyan, a Kurdish female sniper, has survived war by shutting down her emotions. When she learns her younger sister, believed lost during ISIS' 2014 assault, may still be alive in Mosul, she returns to a city shaped by death and destruction. Her search becomes both a rescue mission and a confrontation with the trauma she has spent years trying to silence.
Producer: Halkawt Mustafa, Janne Hjeltnes, John M. Jacobsen

Title: Let's Love
Summary: Ten years after a breakout hit film, screenwriter Nigel, director Andrea, and actors Jackson and Jess reunite in Wales for a fan convention that promises to revive their careers.

Title: A Gangster's Life
Summary: When two low-level criminals scam a vicious London mob and are in over their heads, they flee to rural Greece to avoid the bloody repercussions. But escape isn't that simple.

Title: Starsuckers
Summary: Filmmaker Chris Atkins explores human beings' desire to be famous and how that affects society.

Title: That They May Be One
Summary: On the night before His crucifixion, Jesus prayed a prayer that still echoes across the Church today: "That they may all be one." (John 17) Featuring Francis Chan and Christian leaders from across denominations, That They May Be One is a powerful docudrama exploring how the Holy Spirit has been quietly working across generations to answer that prayer. The film uncovers a remarkable story of God's providence unfolding for more than a century. From the urgent prayers of St. Elena Guerra, which inspired Pope Leo XIII to consecrate the twentieth century to the Holy Spirit, to the dramatic outpouring of the Spirit in Topeka, the historic revival at Azusa Street, and the surprising awakening among Catholics at Duquesne University in 1967, a powerful thread emerges. Through compelling testimony, historical insight, and dramatic reenactments of Pentecost and Jesus' prayer in John 17, the film reveals the Holy Spirit's work across denominational lines, calling the Church to renewal, awakening, and unity. That They May Be One is more than a documentary, it's an invitation to rediscover the Spirit who is still moving today.

Title: Speak
Summary: Freshman high-school student Melinda (Kristen Stewart) has refused to speak ever since she called the cops on a popular summer party. With her old friends snubbing her for being a rat, and her parents (Elizabeth Perkins, D.B. Sweeney) too busy to notice her troubles, she folds into herself, trying to hide her secret: that star senior Andy (Eric Lively) raped her at the party. But Melinda does manage to find solace in her art class headed by Mr. Freeman (Steve Zahn).

Title: La Cruz
Summary: A self-destructive film critic (Norman Briski) sets out to exact revenge upon a painter (Carlos Roffé) whom he believes to have broken up his marriage.

Title: To Set Upright
Summary: Set against the backdrop of Manila's unforgiving streets during the height of the drug war, TIRIK follows Paring Bert, a weary but steadfast priest, and Santos, a rugged taxi driver haunted by his past. Their unexpected journey begins as an act of faith and compassion--an ordinary funeral visit that turns into a day-long odyssey through guilt, redemption, and moral reckoning. As the two men traverse urban chaos and rural silence, they confront the fragile lines between sin and salvation, justice and vengeance. What starts as a road trip becomes a confessional of conscience, where each kilometer peels back their buried truths and tests the limits of their faith in God and in each other. Through moments of grim humor, humanity, and quiet dread, TIRIK asks: how far will a man go to make peace with himself--and at what cost?
Producer: Mai Fanglayan, Charlson L. Ong, May-i Guia Padilla
Screenwriter: Charlson L. Ong, May-i Guia Padilla

Title: Lurk
Summary: A half-drugged woman (Tess Spentzos) battles a masked intruder (Aris Athan) who has broken into her secluded villa.

Title: Jack Johnson: SURFILMUSIC
Summary: SURFILMUSIC a new documentary chronicling Jack Johnson's evolution from surfer to filmmaker to world-renowned musician. The film traces how Johnson's early years making surf films with close friends became a foundation for a much broader creative life, capturing moments in and out of the water that later surfaced in his songwriting. Blending rare footage from those formative surf films and Johnson's personal and family archives with present-day reflections, the film weaves together how lived experience, friendship, and exploration shaped the sound and stories behind the music.
Producer: Wyatt Daily, Daniel Pappas, Tim Wheeler

Title: Buddy, El Ballistico & the Minibike
Summary: With help from his best friend (Marty Gage), a suicidal man (Leon Chabot) performs daredevil stunts to make money.

Title: The Game

Initially harmless, the game grows increasingly personal, and Orton begins to fear for his life as he eludes agents from the mysterious game's organizers. With no one left to trust and his money gone, Orton must find answers for himself.

Title: Dinogeist

Screenwriter: Vivek Bele, Uttam Gada, Aditya Rawal

Title: The Eternity Man
Summary: A war veteran becomes a Christian obsessed with spreading the message of 'eternity' by writing godly graffiti on sidewalks, windows and walls around Sydney.
Producer: Rosemary Blight, Alex Fleetwood, John Wyver

Title: Once Upon a Time in Jersey
Summary: A journey through the 1960s, 70s, & 80s New Jersey -- reflecting on a magical time of the Old Americana we once knew. Featuring Tom Cruise, Bill Maher and Dana Bash from CNN, with a special appearance by Oscar-Nominated actor Danny Aiello.

Title: Gail
Summary: For more than thirty years, Bronx subway worker Gail E Lichtman has devoted nearly every spare dollar and vacation day to following the Canadian rock band Our Lady Peace, attending more than 150 concerts around the world. When the band embarks on an anniversary tour across Canada in the dead of winter, Gail sets out after them by bus, train, and ferry. Through the comedy, exhaustion, and unexpected tensions of the road, her eccentric devotion gradually reveals an intimate portrait of loneliness, joy, and the universal search for purpose, belonging, and hope. Funny, tender, and deeply human, GAIL celebrates the extraordinary meaning that can be found in an ordinary life.

Title: The Last Day
Summary: Inspired by Virginia Woolf’s Mrs. Dalloway, The Last Day unfolds over a single summer day in New York, where the lives of two mothers briefly entwine. Julia, a writer and mother, is unsettled by creative stagnation, unprocessed grief, and the approach of her daughter’s adolescence. An unexpected encounter with Taylor—a labor and delivery nurse in the midst of a postpartum crisis—pushes Julia to reconsider the life she has built, and whether she can rediscover herself within it.
Producer: Lucie Elwes, Rachel Rose, Mason Plotts, Christine Vachon, Pamela Koffler

Title: Frampton
Summary: From the explosive heights of Frampton Comes Alive! to the quiet introspection of his final tour, "Frampton" is an intimate portrait of a rock icon who soared, stumbled, and rose again. This feature documentary traces Peter Frampton's extraordinary life and career -- from his meteoric rise in the 1970s that made him a global sensation, through the turbulent years that tested his artistry, identity, and resilience. As the roar of stadium crowds faded, Frampton faced the daunting task of rebuilding -- reinventing his sound and rediscovering his purpose across solo projects, collaborations, and relentless touring. Behind the stage lights, personal sacrifices and fractured family ties reveal the cost of fame that few ever see. Now, diagnosed with Inclusion Body Myositis, a degenerative muscle condition threatening his ability to play guitar, Frampton stands at a profound crossroads. "Frampton" captures the soulful poignancy of an artist confronting both the passage of time and his own physical limits, determined to make every performance count. Through rare archival footage, candid interviews, and electrifying concert moments, this documentary explores the spirit of a musician who defined an era, lost everything, and fought his way back -- only to discover that his greatest encore might not be on stage, but in the time he's reclaiming with the people he loves most. "Frampton" is a stirring celebration of artistry, endurance, and the enduring power of music to outlast even the hands that play it.

They must make a decision that will test the limits of their love and commitment and ultimately, their marriage.

Title: Adore Him
Summary: ADORE HIM is a new docudrama from the executive producer of the record-breaking and Gabriel Award-winning Jesus Thirsts: The Miracle of the Eucharist (2024) that aims to inspire deeper devotion to Jesus through Eucharistic adoration. While JESUS THIRSTS presented an overarching focus on the Mass, the sequel ADORE HIM aims to teach and inspire Catholics and seekers about the power of Eucharistic Adoration. ADORE HIM invites you to enter the very presence of God. Through cinematic reenactments that span salvation history and intimate modern-day interviews from around the world, this film explores the transforming power of meeting the Creator of the Universe face to face. From encountering the Ark of the Covenant as it traveled across the wilderness to bumping into Jesus as he taught in the marketplace, this story builds to a culmination in the Eucharist, and today millions are finding out how much God truly loves them as they adore Him in the Blessed Sacrament. He is here. Will you come?

While the situation seems idyllic, the couple's isolation begins to wear on their relationship, and eventually the armed conflict that they've tried to flee arrives on the quiet island in the form of soldiers. Try as they might, Jan and Eva ultimately can't evade either the war or their own marital problems.

Summary: Twin sisters face the loss of their home following their mother's death. The loft contains art and items representing the family's history and the history of New York.

But they ignore his pleas and overrun the wagons, leaving him for dead. He manages to escape to the nearest town, but there the law accuses him of deserting the settlers. The townspeople try to lynch him, so he flees to a ranch owned by kindly Nick (Roy Roberts), who lends Jim a trusty horse named Tumbleweed that may just be fast enough to save the day.

While the documentary notes the pastime's positive aspects, specifically including a disabled gamer who finds a sense of freedom online, it depicts people consumed by their dedication to living in a fantasy world. Summary: A widowed woman in her 50s, recovering from a neck injury, sets out to go on 60 dates in six months, facing bad matches, worse advice, and unexpected healing in her hilariously messy comeback to modern love.

Tender and unsparing, featuring electrifying performances and archival recordings, the film reveals how Gregg's unforgettable blend of rock, country and blues mirrored the music and struggles of his soul.

Title: The Leader

The Leader tells the unsettling true story of the religious movement known as “Heaven's Gate”: the UFO cult that convinced dozens to abandon their lives and await evacuation from planet Earth. Heaven’s Gate shocked the world in 1997, when thirty-nine followers committed the largest mass suicide to ever take place on US soil. The film chronicles the leaders "Ti & Do" during their fateful meeting in 
Houston, Texas in the early 1970s through their tragic and disturbing end in Rancho Santa Fe, California in ‘97. The incident became a major global media event -- marked by the group’s matching uniforms, purple shrouds, and Nike sneakers.

Title: My Undesirable Friends: Part II - Exile

Just days before, they were working as part of a vibrant opposition community. Now they're part of a historic exodus. They leave with a few hours' notice, carry-on suitcases, and no idea what country they can go to next that will let them stay and keep working. They must quickly get back on their feet to report on the biggest story of their lives, a war they all fiercely oppose. Intimate and immersive, the film sweeps across four years and a dozen countries. The complex, razor sharp and often very funny women -- and a few men -- gather in apartments that feel like waystations and borrowed offices before being uprooted yet again. They work to bring Russians an alternative to propaganda, speaking out against their country's war crimes and wrestling with personal moral accountability, even as Russia menaces them with criminal prosecution back home and physical threats abroad. Relying on dark humor to get through dark times, they keep working for the uncertain future of a country they may not return to for decades. As the years pass in exile, they have to redefine what work, family, friendship, love and home mean when you can't go home.

The film ultimately becomes a story of reclamation: of space, history, and identity. Of transforming trauma into light. THE LORRAINE reminds us that history is never as neatly resolved as we're taught to believe, and that the fight for justice is still very much evolving.

Summary: Ronald loses his job, his wife and his dignity.

Title: Irkalla: Gilgamesh's Dream
Summary: In Baghdad's streets, Chum-Chum, a diabetic and dreamy nine-year-old, believes the Tigris River hides a gate to Irkalla, the underworld, where he can reunite with his lost parents -- a belief rooted in the legend of Gilgamesh. But when his friend Moody slips into violence and street crime, Chum-Chum must choose between holding on to myth or facing reality. A tale of grief, faith, and the search for light in a city that refuses to die.
Screenwriter: Mohamed Al Daradji, Karim Traidia, Shahad Ameen, Hasan Falih
Production Co: Iraqi Independent Film Center, Human Film, Image Nation, Lionceau Films, Biet Ameen

Title: Troubles
Summary: Marion keeps having violent nightmares. One day she meets Emma. Emma soon realizes that Marion has psychological issues and suggests a strange kind of therapy.

Title: Limerence
Summary: Rosemary, an aspiring painter and free spirit, moves to Venice, Calif., where she falls for Tom, a charismatic gallery director. Their intense chemistry quickly evolves into a serious relationship that puts Rosemary to the test.

Title: Rare Birds
Summary: Dave is ready to call it quits on his marriage and his restaurant. His wife has left him and the restaurant, The Auk, has never really taken off. Desperate, Dave tries to consume the rare delights of his restaurant before they are repossessed. All seems lost until Dave's neighbor, Phonse, proposes a mad scheme to save The Auk. They will announce the presence, in the vicinity of the restaurant, of an extremely rare duck, attracting bird watchers the world over.
Distributor: Studio Home Entertainment, Shadow Distribution, Lionsgate Films, Nexo, Kinowelt Home Entertainment [de]
Production Co: Pope Productions, Rare Productions Ltd. [ca], Big Pictures Entertainment
Sound Mix: Dolby Stereo, Dolby Digital, Dolby A, Dolby SR

Title: The Idiots
Summary: Karen (Bodil Jørgensen) is dining alone at a crowded restaurant when a group of people who seem to be mentally disabled enter and disrupt everyone's meal. Discerning that they are not what they seem, Karen returns with the group to the large communal house they inhabit with charismatic Stoffer (Jens Albinus). This group of intellectuals is attempting to challenge bourgeois ideology by behaving like "idiots" in public. Karen, however, may take the act further than any of them had planned.

Title: Deadly Destination Wedding
Summary: After flying to her friend's wedding, a lawyer begins a fling with a stranger she met on the plane. But when her passport disappears and no one at the wedding has ever heard of him, she realizes the man she trusted may have trapped her in paradise.
Producer: Charles Arthur Berg, Brian Nolan, Margarita Reyes, Peter Sullivan

Title: The Corner
Summary: When a baby sitter gets the kids settled and sits down in front of the TV, things get deadly.
Producer: Jaysen P. Buterin, Jesse H. Knight

Title: How Hard Can It Be?
Summary: Sparks fly between an ambitious New York magazine reporter and a former Marine when she travels to Alabama to do a story on the best small town in America.
Producer: Jim Klock, Jake Helgren, Autumn Federici

Title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
Summary: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

Title: Citizen Osama
Summary:
In the northern part of the besieged Gaza Strip, cut off from all aid and medical services, Osama lives with his wife and their newborn baby. His son was born in the eighth month of this never-ending war, in a hospital overwhelmed by death and
lacking the resources needed for childbirth. Once aspiring to become an artistic photographer, 33-year-old Osama has unexpectedly become a war photographer. Wearing a bulletproof vest and a journalist’s helmet, he travels through devastated areas, documenting the destruction while trying to help others. Osama’s daily life revolves around the struggle for survival, as he searches for food, water and a safe place for his family. The emotional burden is immense, especially when he captures the deaths and funerals of fellow journalists, friends and loved ones. Despite the psychological pressure, Osama believes he must continue documenting the war and protecting his family. He hopes for an end to the violence, or at least a ceasefire to ease the suffering of civilians. Citizen Osama is a film that portrays his life. It offers a window into the resilience, fear and humanity of those trapped in one of the most violent conflicts in the world.

Title: Last Summer
Summary: Sandy (Barbara Hershey), Dan (Bruce Davison) and Peter (Richard Thomas) are three affluent, spoiled teens spending a lazy summer on Fire Island, N.Y. Both boys pepper Sandy with sexual advances, which she clearly relishes. Into their tight triangle comes chubby and naive Rhoda (Catherine Burns). Like the injured seagull Sandy both nurtures and tortures, Rhoda becomes a figure of sport, teased and humiliated by the group. Sandy's cruelty and influence bring the summer to a shocking climax.
Producer: Sidney Beckerman, Alfred W. Crown, Emanuel L. Wolf

Title: TWIG
Summary: A woman dreams of escape from a divided Dublin. Her brother's gangland feud traps the people in a culture of fear, surveillance and containment. When tragedy strikes, she seeks to do the right thing, stand up to King Leon and face her fate.

Title: Gaman
Summary: Ghulam Hasan, a migrant from Uttar Pradesh, goes to Mumbai and tries to find a foothold in his new life as a taxi driver.

Title: SHEEPDOG
Summary: Decorated U.S. Army combat veteran Calvin Cole is court ordered into treatment and into the care of a VA trauma therapist in-training. Things become even more complicated when Calvin's father-in-law and a retired Vietnam Veteran, shows up on his doorstep having just been released from prison. As Calvin's plan to run from his past becomes even more challenging, he learns through the support of his community: tough love and compassion, that he must put himself back together again for his family -- and for himself.
Producer: Lynn K. D'Angona, Steven Grayhm, P. Colin Kane, Jose Martinez Jr.

Title: Censor Addiction
Summary: In 2030, a group of former employees band together to take down a corrupt medical giant determined to increase the levels of crime throughout the country.
Producer: Marnette Patterson, Michael Matteo Rossi, Erica Tenaglia
